  1206                              <1> 	; 18/05/2025
  1207                              <1> 	; 17/05/2025
  1208                              <1> 	; 16/05/2025 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.10)
  1209                              <1> 	; 26/08/2024 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.9)
  1210                              <1> 	; 28/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  1211                              <1> 	; 20/11/2017
  1212                              <1> 	; 14/02/2016
  1213                              <1> 	; 13/02/2016
  1214                              <1> 	; 10/02/2016
  1215                              <1> 	; 06/02/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  1216                              <1> 	; 14/08/2010
  1217                              <1> 	; 19/09/2009
  1218                              <1>         ; 2005
  1219                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  1220                              <1> 	;	ESI = DOS DirEntry Format FileName Address
  1221                              <1> 	;	AL = Attributes Mask
  1222                              <1> 	;	(<AL AND EntryAttrib> must be equal to AL)
  1223                              <1> 	;	AH = Negative Attributes Mask (If AH>0)
  1224                              <1> 	;	(<AH AND EntryAttrib> must be ZERO)
  1225                              <1> 	;	CH > 0 Find First Free Dir Entry or Deleted Entry
  1226                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 -> Return the First Free Dir Entry
  1227                              <1> 	;	CL = E5h -> Return the 1st deleted entry
  1228                              <1> 	;	CL = FFh -> Return the 1st deleted or free entry
  1229                              <1> 	;	CL > 0 and CL <> E5h and CL <> FFh -> Return the first
  1230                              <1> 	;	     proper entry (which fits with Atributes Masks)
  1231                              <1> 	;	CX = 0 Find Valid File/Directory/VolumeName
  1232                              <1> 	;	? = Any One Char
  1233                              <1> 	;	* = Every Chars
  1234                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  1235                              <1> 	;	EDI = Directory Entry Address (in Directory Buffer)
  1236                              <1> 	;	ESI = DOS DirEntry Format FileName Address
  1237                              <1> 	;	CF = 0 -> No Error, Proper Entry
  1238                              <1> 	;	DL = Attributes
  1239                              <1> 	;	DH = Previous Entry Attr (LongName Check)
  1240                              <1> 	;	;AL > 0 -> Ambiguous filename wildcard "?" used
  1241                              <1> 	;	;AH > 0 -> Ambiguous filename wildcard "*" used
  1242                              <1> 	;	;AX = 0 -> Filename full fits with directory entry
  1243                              <1> 	;       18/05/2025
  1244                              <1> 	;	AL bit 0, 1 -> "?" used (bit 1 for name ext.)
  1245                              <1> 	;	AL bit 2, 3 -> '*' used (bit 3 for name ext.)
  1246                              <1> 	;	AL = 0 -> Filename full fits with directory entry
  1247                              <1> 	;	CH = The 1st Name Char of Current Dir Entry
  1248                              <1> 	;	CF = 1 -> Proper entry not found, Error Code in EAX/AL
  1249                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 and CH = 0 -> Free Entry (End Of Dir)
  1250                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 and CH = E5h -> Deleted Entry fits with filters
  1251                              <1> 	;	CL > 0 -> Entry not found, CH invalid
  1252                              <1> 	;	CF = 0 ->
  1253                              <1> 	;	EBX = Current Directory Entry Index/Number (BX)
  1254                              <1> 	;
  1255                              <1> 	;	; 29/05/2025
  1256                              <1> 	; 	If cf = 0 ->
  1257                              <1> 	; 	[DirEntry_Counter] = directory entry index number
  1258                              <1> 	;		from the start of the directory (found)
  1259                              <1> 	; 	If cf = 1 ->
  1260                              <1> 	;   	[DirEntry_Counter] = the last direntry index number
  1261                              <1> 	;		from the start of the directory (not found)
  1262                              <1> 
  1263                              <1> 	;mov	word [DirBuff_EntryCounter], 0 ; Zero Based

  1454                              <1> 	; 19/07/2025
  1455                              <1> 	; 02/06/2025
  1456                              <1> 	; 29/05/2025
  1457                              <1> 	; 18/05/2025
  1458                              <1> 	; 17/05/2025
  1459                              <1> 	; 16/05/2025 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.10)
  1460                              <1> 	; 28/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  1461                              <1> 	; 02/03/2021 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.3) ((BugFix))
  1462                              <1> 	; 14/02/2016
  1463                              <1> 	; 13/02/2016
  1464                              <1> 	; 10/02/2016
  1465                              <1> 	; 06/02/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  1466                              <1> 	; 14/08/2010 (DIR.ASM, "proc_find_direntry")
  1467                              <1> 	; 19/09/2009
  1468                              <1> 	; 2005
  1469                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  1470                              <1> 	;	16/05/2025
  1471                              <1> 	;	EDI = Directory Buffer Address (512 bytes, data)
  1472                              <1> 	;	;;;
  1473                              <1> 	;	ESI = Sub Dir or File Name Address
  1474                              <1> 	;	AL = Attributes Mask
  1475                              <1> 	;	(<AL AND EntryAttrib> must be equal to AL)
  1476                              <1> 	;	AH = Negative Attributes Mask (If AH>0)
  1477                              <1> 	;	(<AH AND EntryAttrib> must be ZERO)
  1478                              <1> 	;	CH > 0 Find First Free Dir Entry or Deleted Entry
  1479                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 -> Return the First Free Dir Entry
  1480                              <1> 	;	CL = E5h -> Return the 1st deleted entry
  1481                              <1> 	;	CL = FFh -> Return the 1st deleted or free entry
  1482                              <1> 	;	CL > 0 and CL <> E5h and CL <> FFh -> Return the first
  1483                              <1> 	;            proper entry (which fits with Atributes Masks)
  1484                              <1> 	;	CX = 0 -> Find Valid File/Directory/VolumeName
  1485                              <1> 	;	? = Any One Char
  1486                              <1> 	;	* = Every Chars
  1487                              <1> 	;	EBX = Current Dir Entry (BX) < 16 ; 17/05/2025
  1488                              <1> 	;
  1489                              <1> 	;	; 29/05/2025
  1490                              <1> 	;	[DirBuff_EntryCounter] = entry index from the start
  1491                              <1> 	;
  1492                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  1493                              <1> 	;	EDI = Directory Entry Address (in DirectoryBuffer)
  1494                              <1> 	;	ESI = Sub Dir or File Name Address
  1495                              <1> 	;	CF = 0 -> No Error, Proper Entry
  1496                              <1> 	;	DL = Attributes
  1497                              <1> 	;	DH = Previous Entry Attr (LongName Check)
  1498                              <1> 	;	;AL > 0 -> Ambiguous filename wildcard "?" used
  1499                              <1> 	;	;AH > 0 -> Ambiguous filename wildcard "*" used
  1500                              <1> 	;	;AX = 0 -> Filename full fits with directory entry
  1501                              <1> 	;       18/05/2025
  1502                              <1> 	;	AL bit 0, 1 -> "?" used (bit 1 for name ext.)
  1503                              <1> 	;	AL bit 2, 3 -> '*' used (bit 3 for name ext.)
  1504                              <1> 	;	AL = 0 -> Filename full fits with directory entry
  1505                              <1> 	;	EBX = CurrentDirEntry (BX)
  1506                              <1> 	;	CH = The 1st Name Char of Current Dir Entry
  1507                              <1> 	;	CF = 1 -> Proper entry not found, Error Code in AX/AL
  1508                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 and CH = 0 -> Free Entry (End Of Dir)
  1509                              <1> 	;	CL = 0 and CH = E5h -> Deleted Entry fits with filters
  1510                              <1> 	;	CL > 0 -> Entry not found, CH invalid
  1511                              <1> 	;
  1512                              <1> 	;	; 29/05/2025
  1513                              <1> 	;	[DirBuff_EntryCounter] = entry index from the start
  1514                              <1> 	;				(or the last entry found)
  1515                              <1> 	;
  1516                              <1> 	; (EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, EDI, EBP will be changed)
  1517                              <1> 
  1518                              <1> 	;cmp	bx, [DirBuff_LastEntry]
  1519                              <1> 	;ja	short loc_ffde_stc_retn_255 ; 28/07/2022
  1520                              <1> 	; 17/05/2025
  1521                              <1> 	; 16/05/2025
  1522                              <1> 	;cmp	ebx, 16 ; 512/32
  1523                              <1> 	;jnb	short loc_ffde_stc_retn_255
  1524                              <1>

  2204                              <1> save_longname_sub_component:
  2205                              <1> 	; 19/07/2025
  2206                              <1> 	; 25/05/2025
  2207                              <1> 	; 20/05/2025 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.10)
  2208                              <1> 	;	-Major Modification-
  2209                              <1> 	; 13/02/2016
  2210                              <1> 	; 06/02/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  2211                              <1> 	; 28/02/2010
  2212                              <1> 	; 17/10/2009
  2213                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  2214                              <1> 	;	EDI = Directory Entry
  2215                              <1> 	;     	// This procedure is called
  2216                              <1> 	;	// from 'find_directory_entry' procedure.
  2217                              <1> 	;	// If the last entry returns with
  2218                              <1> 	;	// a non-zero LongnameFound value and
  2219                              <1> 	;	// if LFN_CheckSum value is equal to
  2220                              <1> 	;	// the next shortname checksum,
  2221                              <1> 	;	// long name is valid.
  2222                              <1> 	;	// If a longname is longer than 65 bytes,
  2223                              <1> 	;	// it is invalid for trdos. (>45h)
  2224                              <1> 	;
  2225                              <1> 	; 20/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  2226                              <1> 	;	According to
  2227                              <1> 	;	Microsoft FAT32 File System Specification
  2228                              <1> 	;   ... Long names are limited to 255 chars,
  2229                              <1> 	;	(UCS-2, 2-byte character set)
  2230                              <1> 	;	not including the trailing NUL. ...
  2231                              <1> 	;   ... Total path length of can not exceed
  2232                              <1> 	;	260 chars including the trailing NUL. ...
  2233                              <1> 	;	(520 bytes)
  2234                              <1> 	;   So, in this version of TRDOS 386
  2235                              <1> 	;	UNICODE chars (two bytes) will be converted
  2236                              <1> 	;	to ASCII chars only using low bytes of
  2237                              <1> 	;	of two byte UNICODE chars,
  2238                              <1> 	;	as a very simple method.
  2239                              <1> 	;	(if the high byte is not zero,
  2240                              <1> 	;	 low byte will be returned as '_')
  2241                              <1> 	;
  2242                              <1> 	;	! 25/05/2025 !
  2243                              <1> 	;	TRDOS 386 v2.1 (v2.0.10) will use only
  2244                              <1> 	;	260 bytes (130 2-byte characters) buffer
  2245                              <1> 	;	for FAT LFN type long names. And TRDOS 386
  2246                              <1> 	;	kernel will ignore long file names if the
  2247                              <1> 	;	length is longer/more than 260 bytes.
  2248                              <1> 	;	(in other words: more than 10 LFN entries)
  2249                              <1> 	;	And the kernel will use unicode to ascii
  2250                              <1> 	;	conversion.. As result of the conversion,
  2251                              <1> 	;	ASCIIZ equivalent of the long name
  2252                              <1> 	;	will be returned with max. 128+NUL chars.
  2253                              <1> 	;	(260 byte limit -> LDIR_Ord byte,
  2254                              <1> 	;	"Last Long Entry" mark is 41h to 4Ah.)
  2255                              <1> 	;
  2256                              <1> 	;	(ASCIIZ name buffer size will be 129 bytes)
  2257                              <1> 	;	((unicode LFN buffer will be 260 bytes))
  2258                              <1> 	;
  2259                              <1> 	; Modified registers: NONE ; 19/07/2025 
  2260                              <1> 	;	ECX ; 20/05/2025
  2261                              <1> 	;
  2262                              <1>

  2769                              <1> find_longname:
  2770                              <1> 	; 24/06/2025
  2771                              <1> 	; 20/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  2772                              <1> 	;	-verified-
  2773                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)

  2776                              <1> 	; 17/10/2009
  2777                              <1> 
  2778                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  2779                              <1> 	;	ESI = DOS short file name address
  2780                              <1> 	; 	for example: "filename.ext"
  2781                              <1> 	;
  2782                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  2783                              <1> 	; 	ESI = ASCIIZ longname address (cf = 0)
  2784                              <1> 	;	cf = 1 -> error number returns in EAX (AL)
  2785                              <1> 	;	AL = 0 & CF=1 -> longname not found
  2786                              <1> 	;	     the file/directory has no longname
  2787                              <1> 	; 	cf = 0 -> AL = FAT Type
  2788                              <1> 
  2789                              <1> 	; 17/10/2009
  2790                              <1> 	; ASCIIZ string will be returned
  2791                              <1> 	; as LongFileName
  2792                              <1> 	; clearing/reset is not needed
  2793                              <1> 	;mov	ecx, 33
  2794                              <1> 	;mov	edi, LongFileName

  2798                              <1> 	;mov	byte [LongNameFound], 0
  2799                              <1> 
  2800                              <1> 	; ESI = ASCIIZ file/directory name address
  2801                              <1> 	;   AL = Attributes AND mask 
  2802                              <1> 	;	(Result of AND must be equal to AL)
  2803                              <1> 	;   AH = Negative attributes mask
  2804                              <1> 	;	(Result of AND must be ZERO)
  2805 0000AF13 66B80008            <1> 	mov	ax, 0800h
  2806                              <1> 		; it must not be volume name or longname
  2807 0000AF17 E8C2DCFFFF          <1> 	call	find_first_file

  2809                              <1> 
  2810                              <1> 	; 24/06/2025

  2813                              <1> 	;jnb	short loc_fln_check_longname_yes_sign
  2814                              <1> 	;
  2815                              <1> 	;;call	get_fs_longname
  2816                              <1> 	;;retn
  2817                              <1> 	;; 29/07/2022

  2861                              <1> calculate_checksum:
  2862                              <1> 	; 20/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  2863                              <1> 	;	-verified-
  2864                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  2865                              <1> 	; 13/02/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  2866                              <1> 	; 17/10/2009 (DIR.ASM, 'proc_calculate_checksum')
  2867                              <1>         ;
  2868                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  2869                              <1> 	;	ESI = 11 byte DOS File Name location
  2870                              <1> 	;	(in DOS Directory Entry Format)
  2871                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  2872                              <1> 	;	 AL = 8 bit checksum (CRC) value
  2873                              <1> 	;
  2874                              <1> 	; (Modified registers: EAX, ECX, ESI)
  2875                              <1> 
  2876                              <1> 	; Erdogan Tan [ 17-10-2009 ]
  2877                              <1> 	;  'ror al, 1' instruction
  2878                              <1> 
  2879                              <1> 	; Erdogan Tan [ 20-06-2004 ]
  2880                              <1> 	; This 8086 assembly code is an original code
  2881                              <1> 	; which is adapted from C code in
  2882                              <1> 	; Microsoft FAT32 File System Specification
  2883                              <1> 	; Version 1.03, December 6, 2000

  3440                              <1> clear_directory_buffer:
  3441                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  3442                              <1> 	;
  3443                              <1> 	; eax = 0
  3444                              <1> 	; ecx = directory buffer sector count (<= 128)
  3445                              <1> 	;

  3452                              <1> 	shr	eax, 2 ; 'byte count / 4' for 'stosd'

  3820                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)

  3824                              <1> 	; 17/07/2010
  3825                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  3826                              <1> 	; 	EDI = Directory Entry Address
  3827                              <1> 	;	ESI = Dot File Name Location
  3828                              <1> 	;	EAX = First Cluster
  3829                              <1> 	;	File Size = 0 (Must be set later)

  3837                              <1> 	;	Otherwise file size is as dword [EBX] (*)
  3838                              <1> 	;	DX = Date, AX = Time in DOS Dir Entry format
  3839                              <1> 	;	EBX = same
  3840                              <1> 	;	ECX = same

  3845                              <1> 	mov	[edi+26], ax ; FClusterLw, 26
  3846                              <1> 	shr	eax, 16
  3847                              <1> 	mov	[edi+20], ax ; FClusterHw, 20

  3849                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022
  3850                              <1> 	xor	eax, eax
  3851                              <1> 	mov	[edi+12], ax ; NTReserved, 12
  3852                              <1> 			     ; CrtTimeTenth, 13
  3853                              <1> 	or	ch, ch
  3854                              <1> 	jz	short loc_make_direntry_set_filesize
  3855                              <1> 
  3856                              <1> 	mov	eax, [ebx]
  3857                              <1>

  3860                              <1> 
  3861                              <1> 	call	convert_file_name
  3862                              <1> 	; EDI = Dir Entry Format File Name Location
  3863                              <1> 	; ESI = Dot File Name Location (capitalized)
  3864                              <1> 
  3865                              <1> 	call	convert_current_date_time
  3866                              <1> 	; OUTPUT -> DX = Date in dos dir entry format
  3867                              <1>         ; 	    AX = Time in dos dir entry format
  3868                              <1> 	mov	[edi+14], ax ; CrtTime, 14
  3869                              <1> 	mov	[edi+16], dx ; CrtDate, 16

  4411                              <1> 	;

  4754                              <1> remove_file:
  4755                              <1> 	; 01/01/2026
  4756                              <1> 	; 21/07/2025 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.10)
  4757                              <1> 	;  (Ref: DOS_DELETE, Retro DOS v5.0 - ibmdos7.s)
  4758                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  4759                              <1> 	; 15/10/2016

  4761                              <1> 	; 10/04/2011 (FILE.ASM, 'proc_delete_file')
  4762                              <1> 	; 09/08/2010
  4763                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  4764                              <1> 	;	EDI = Directory Buffer Entry Address
  4765                              <1> 	;	21/07/2025
  4766                              <1> 	;	ECX = Directory Buffer Entry Counter/Index
  4767                              <1> 	;	 BL = Longname Entry Length
  4768                              <1> 	;	 BH = Logical DOS Drive Number
  4769                              <1> 	;

  4771                              <1> 	;  If CF = 1 -> Error code in EAX (AL)

  5209                              <1> 	;   Phase 1 -> Check destination file,
  5210                              <1> 	;              'not found' is required
  5211                              <1> 	;   Phase 2 -> Check source file
  5212                              <1> 	;              'found' and proper attributes is required
  5213                              <1> 	;   Phase 3 -> Make destination directory entry,
  5214                              <1> 	;           add new dir cluster or section if it is required

  5235                              <1> 	;        EBX = Destination file structure offset

  5237                              <1> 	;        cf = 1 -> Error code in EAX (AL)

  5931                              <1> 	; 02/09/2011 (FILE.ASM 'copy_source_file_to_destination_file')
  5932                              <1> 	; 01/08/2010 - 18/05/2011
  5933                              <1> 	;
  5934                              <1> 	;   Command Interpreter phase 1 enter ->
  5935                              <1> 	;           AL = 1 -> Caller is command interpreter
  5936                              <1> 	;           AL = 2 -> The second call, re-enter/continue
  5937                              <1> 	;   Phase 1 -> Check source file
  5938                              <1> 	;              'found' is required
  5939                              <1> 	;   Phase 2 -> Check destination file,
  5940                              <1> 	;              save 'found' or 'not found' status
  5941                              <1> 	;              'permission denied' error will be return
  5942                              <1> 	;              if attributes have not for ordinary file
  5943                              <1> 	;              without readonly attribute
  5944                              <1> 	;   Command Interpreter phase 1 return ->
  5945                              <1> 	;              DH = Source file attributes
  5946                              <1> 	;              DL = Destination file found status
  5947                              <1> 	;              EAX = 0
  5948                              <1> 	;   Command Interpreter phase 2 enter ->
  5949                              <1> 	;              AL = 2 -> Continue from the last position
  5950                              <1> 	;              AH =
  5951                              <1> 	;   Phase 3 -> Load source file or use read/write cluster method
  5952                              <1> 	;   Phase 4 -> Create destination file if it is not found
  5953                              <1> 	;   Phase 5 -> Open destination file
  5954                              <1> 	;   Phase 6 -> Read from source and write to destination
  5955                              <1> 	;   Phase 7 -> Unload source file, if it is loaded at memory
  5956                              <1> 	;       cf = 1 causes to return before the phase 7
  5957                              <1> 	;              but loaded file will be unloaded
  5958                              <1> 	;	       (allocated memory block will be deallocated)
  5959                              <1> 	;
  5960                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  5961                              <1> 	;	 ESI = Source File Pathname (Asciiz)
  5962                              <1> 	;        EDI = Destination File Pathname (Asciiz)
  5963                              <1> 	;        AL = 0 --> Interrupt (System call)
  5964                              <1> 	;        AL > 0 --> Command Interpreter (Question)
  5965                              <1> 	;        AL = 1 --> Question Phase
  5966                              <1> 	;        AL = 2 --> Progress Phase
  5967                              <1> 	;
  5968                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  5969                              <1> 	;	cf = 0 -> OK ; (*)
  5970                              <1> 	;	EAX = Destination file first cluster
  5971                              <1> 	;
  5972                              <1> 	;	31/08/2024 - TRDOS v2.0.9 ; (*)
  5973                              <1> 	; obsolete ;CL > 0 if there is file reading error before EOF
  5974                              <1> 	;          ;	        (incomplete copy)
  5975                              <1> 	;          ;CH > 0 if file is (full) loaded at memory
  5976                              <1> 	;
  5977                              <1> 	;	cf = 1 -> Error code in AL (EAX) ; (*)
  5978                              <1> 	;
  5979                              <1> 	; (Modified registers: eax, ebx, ecx, edx, esi, edi, ebp)

  8584                              <1> ; 28/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  8585                              <1> ;----------------------------------------------------------
  8586                              <1> ; (Windows) FAT long file name (LFN) to DOS short file name
  8587                              <1> ; conversion
  8588                              <1> 
  8589                              <1> ; 26/05/2025
  8590                              <1> ; TRDOS 386 v2.0.10 - Long to short file name conversion
  8591                              <1> ;
  8592                              <1> ; REF:
  8593                              <1> ; Microsoft - Long Filename Specification
  8594                              <1> ; Version 0.5, December 4, 1992
  8595                              <1> ;
  8596                              <1> ; The following steps are used to form an 8.3 basis from a long name.
  8597                              <1> ;
  8598                              <1> ; 1. Remove all spaces. For example "My File" becomes "MyFile".
  8599                              <1> ;
  8600                              <1> ; 2. Initial periods, trailing periods, and extra periods prior to 
  8601                              <1> ;    the last embedded period are removed.
  8602                              <1> ;
  8603                              <1> ;    For example ".logon" becomes "logon", "junk.c.o" becomes "junkc.o",
  8604                              <1> ;    and "main." becomes "main".
  8605                              <1> ;
  8606                              <1> ; 3. Translate all illegal 8.3 characters into "_" (underscore).
  8607                              <1> ;    
  8608                              <1> ;    For example, "The[First]Folder" becomes "The_First_Folder".
  8609                              <1> ;
  8610                              <1> ; 4. If the name does not contain an extension then truncate it to 6 characters.
  8611                              <1> ;    If the names does contain an extension, then truncate the first part 
  8612                              <1> ;    to 6 characters and the extension to 3 characters.
  8613                              <1> ;
  8614                              <1> ;    For example, "I Am A Dingbat" becomes "IAmADi" and not "IAmADing.bat",
  8615                              <1> ;    and "Super Duper Editor.Exe" becomes "SuperD.Exe".
  8616                              <1> ;
  8617                              <1> ; 5. If the name does not contain an extension then a "~1" is appended to
  8618                              <1> ;    the name. If the name does contain an extension, then a "~1" is appended
  8619                              <1> ;    to the first part of the name, prior to the extension.
  8620                              <1> ;
  8621                              <1> ;    For example, "MyFile" becomes "MyFile~1, and "Junk.bat" becomes "Junk~1.bat".
  8622                              <1> ;
  8623                              <1> ;    This numeric value is always added to help reduce the conflicts
  8624                              <1> ;    in the 8.3 name space for automatic generated names.
  8625                              <1> ;
  8626                              <1> ; 6. This step is optional dependent on the name colliding with an existing file.
  8627                              <1> ;    To resolve collisions the decimal number, that was set to 1, is incremented
  8628                              <1> ;    until the name is unique. The number of characters needed to store the number
  8629                              <1> ;    will grow as necessary from 1 digit to 2 digits and so on.
  8630                              <1> ;    If the  length of the basis (ignoring the extension) plus the dash and number
  8631                              <1> ;    exceeds 8 characters then the length of the basis is shortened until
  8632                              <1> ;    the new name fits in 8 characters.
  8633                              <1> ;
  8634                              <1> ;    For example, if "FILENA~1.EXE" conflicts the next names tried are
  8635                              <1> ;    "FILENA~2.EXE", "FILENA~3.EXE", ..., "FILEN~10.EXE", "FILEN~11.EXE", etc
  8636                              <1> ;
  8637                              <1> ; 26/05/2025 - Erdogan Tan
  8638                              <1> ; Note: If the long name is the same as it's short name converted to lower case,
  8639                              <1> ;	Windows 7 sets DIR_NTRes (directory entry) byte to 08h.
  8640                              <1> ;       For example: The created file name "denemefn" is written into
  8641                              <1> ;	the directory as the short name "DENEMEFN" without the long name entry,
  8642                              <1> ;	but 'DIR_NTRes' byte (reserved and suggested -by microsoft-
  8643                              <1> ;	to set it as zero) is set to 08h.)
  8644                              <1> ; 	((DIR_NTRes byte is at offset 12 of a directory entry.))
  8645                              <1> 
  8646                              <1> convert_name_from_lfn:
  8647                              <1> 	; 17/06/2025
  8648                              <1> 	; 28/05/2025
  8649                              <1> 	; 27/05/2025
  8650                              <1> 	; 26/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  8651                              <1> 	;
  8652                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  8653                              <1> 	;	ESI = long file name (asciiz format)
  8654                              <1> 	; 	      (max. 128 chars)
  8655                              <1> 	;	EDI = target file name address
  8656                              <1> 	;
  8657                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  8658                              <1> 	;	EDI = target file name address of
  8659                              <1> 	;	      dos 8.3 file name
  8660                              <1> 	;	EAX = 0 if the name does not contain tilde
  8661                              <1> 	;	    = tilde position (if > 0)
  8662                              <1> 	;	if EAX = -1 -> Invalid file name error !
  8663                              <1> 	;
  8664                              <1> 	; Modified registers: EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX
  8665                              <1> 
  8666                              <1> 	;mov	[f_base_start], edi
  8667 0000C166 893D[4DAE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_target], edi
  8668 0000C16C 31DB                <1> 	xor	ebx, ebx
  8669 0000C16E 891D[51AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_base_count], ebx ; 0
  8670                              <1> 	; 17/06/2025
  8671                              <1> 	;mov	[f_base_count], bl ; 0
  8672 0000C174 891D[55AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_ext_start], ebx ; 0
  8673 0000C17A 891D[59AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_ext_count], ebx ; 0
  8674                              <1> 	;mov	[f_ext_count], bl ; 0
  8675 0000C180 881D[61AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[lossy_conversion], bl ; 0
  8676 0000C186 881D[F0AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[conv_ucase], bl ; 0
  8677                              <1> 
  8678                              <1> 	; 28/05/2025 - Erdogan Tan
  8679                              <1> 	; if the long name contains space(s) between words
  8680                              <1> 	;    it must be accepted as 'lossy conversion'.
  8681                              <1> 	; for example:
  8682                              <1> 	;  'de ne me.txt' is not same with 'deneme.txt';
  8683                              <1> 	;  so, short name of 'de ne me.txt' must
  8684                              <1> 	;  be 'DENEME~1.TXT', not 'DENEME.TXT'.
  8685                              <1> 	
  8686 0000C18C 57                  <1> 	push	edi ; *
  8687 0000C18D 56                  <1> 	push	esi ; **
  8688                              <1> 
  8689                              <1> 	; temporary name space on bss section
  8690 0000C18E BF[6FAE0100]        <1> 	mov	edi, temp_name ; max. 128 bytes + zero
  8691                              <1> 
  8692 0000C193 B980000000          <1> 	mov	ecx, 128
  8693                              <1> 
  8694                              <1> 	;xor	ebx, ebx
  8695                              <1> 
  8696                              <1> 	; remove spaces and dots at first
  8697                              <1> 	; and save the last dot position
  8698                              <1> 	; (if the last dot is not the end of file
  8699                              <1> 	;  it will be inserted in same position)
  8700                              <1> 
  8701 0000C198 89FA                <1> 	mov	edx, edi ; *
  8702                              <1> 	;mov	[f_base_start], edi
  8703                              <1> conv_f_lfn_1:	; remove spaces & dots
  8704 0000C19A AC                  <1> 	lodsb
  8705 0000C19B 3C20                <1> 	cmp	al, 20h
  8706 0000C19D 7233                <1> 	jb	short conv_f_lfn_6
  8707 0000C19F 7709                <1> 	ja	short conv_f_lfn_2
  8708 0000C1A1 800D[61AE0100]01    <1> 	or	byte [lossy_conversion], 1
  8709 0000C1A8 EB26                <1> 	jmp	short conv_f_lfn_5
  8710                              <1> conv_f_lfn_2:
  8711 0000C1AA 3C2E                <1> 	cmp	al, '.'
  8712 0000C1AC 7521                <1> 	jne	short conv_f_lfn_4
  8713 0000C1AE 88D8                <1> 	mov	al, bl
  8714 0000C1B0 89FB                <1> 	mov	ebx, edi ; the last dot
  8715 0000C1B2 29D3                <1> 	sub	ebx, edx
  8716 0000C1B4 7404                <1> 	jz	short conv_f_lfn_3 ; .fname
  8717 0000C1B6 20C0                <1> 	and	al, al
  8718 0000C1B8 7416                <1> 	jz	short conv_f_lfn_5 ; the 1st dot
  8719                              <1> conv_f_lfn_3:
  8720 0000C1BA 800D[61AE0100]01    <1> 	or	byte [lossy_conversion], 1
  8721 0000C1C1 EB0D                <1> 	jmp	short conv_f_lfn_5
  8722                              <1> 
  8723                              <1> 	; 28/05/2025
  8724                              <1> nul_lfn:
  8725 0000C1C3 5E                  <1> 	pop	esi ; **
  8726 0000C1C4 5F                  <1> 	pop	edi ; *
  8727 0000C1C5 C60700              <1> 	mov	byte [edi], 0
  8728                              <1> 	; Invalid file name error !
  8729 0000C1C8 B8FFFFFFFF          <1> 	mov	eax, -1
  8730 0000C1CD F9                  <1> 	stc	; cf = 1
  8731 0000C1CE C3                  <1> 	retn
  8732                              <1> 
  8733                              <1> conv_f_lfn_4:	; not_dot
  8734 0000C1CF AA                  <1> 	stosb
  8735                              <1> conv_f_lfn_5:
  8736 0000C1D0 E2C8                <1> 	loop	conv_f_lfn_1
  8737                              <1> conv_f_lfn_6:
  8738 0000C1D2 89D6                <1> 	mov	esi, edx ; *
  8739 0000C1D4 89F9                <1> 	mov	ecx, edi
  8740                              <1> 
  8741                              <1> 	; zero tail
  8742                              <1> 	;xor	eax, eax ; 0
  8743                              <1> 	;stosb
  8744                              <1> 
  8745                              <1> 	; ebx = the last dot position (index)
  8746                              <1> 
  8747 0000C1D6 29F1                <1> 	sub	ecx, esi ; number of chars
  8748                              <1> 	 	 ; (without spaces)
  8749 0000C1D8 74E9                <1> 	jz	short nul_lfn  ; invalid file name !
  8750                              <1> 
  8751 0000C1DA 890D[51AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_base_count], ecx
  8752                              <1> 	; 17/06/2025
  8753                              <1> 	;mov	[f_base_count], cl
  8754                              <1> 
  8755 0000C1E0 8B3D[4DAE0100]      <1> 	mov	edi, [f_target] ; (*)
  8756                              <1> 
  8757                              <1> 	;; eax = 0
  8758                              <1> 
  8759 0000C1E6 21DB                <1> 	and	ebx, ebx
  8760 0000C1E8 7437                <1> 	jz	short check_base ; ecx > 0 ; not dot
  8761                              <1> 
  8762 0000C1EA 39D9                <1> 	cmp	ecx, ebx
  8763                              <1> 	;je	short skip_extension
  8764                              <1> 		; the last char of the LFN is dot
  8765 0000C1EC 7709                <1> 	ja	short conv_f_lfn_7
  8766                              <1> 
  8767                              <1> 	; the last char of the LFN is dot
  8768 0000C1EE 800D[61AE0100]01    <1> 	or	byte [lossy_conversion], 1
  8769 0000C1F5 EB52                <1> 	jmp	short skip_extension
  8770                              <1> 
  8771                              <1> conv_f_lfn_7:
  8772 0000C1F7 29D9                <1> 	sub	ecx, ebx ; base count - dot position
  8773 0000C1F9 87CB                <1> 	xchg	ecx, ebx
  8774 0000C1FB 891D[59AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_ext_count], ebx
  8775                              <1> 	; 17/06/2025
  8776                              <1> 	;mov	[f_ext_count], bl
  8777 0000C201 890D[51AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_base_count], ecx
  8778                              <1> 	; 17/06/2025
  8779                              <1> 	;mov	[f_base_count], cl
  8780                              <1> 
  8781 0000C207 01CA                <1> 	add	edx, ecx ; temp_name + dot pos
  8782 0000C209 8915[55AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_ext_start], edx
  8783                              <1> 
  8784 0000C20F 83FB03              <1> 	cmp	ebx, 3 ; extension length > 3
  8785 0000C212 760D                <1> 	jna	short check_base

  9120                              <1> 	; Convert UNICODE long name
  9121                              <1> 	;	  to ASCIIZ long name
  9122                              <1> 	; Input:

  9124                              <1> 	;	(max. 260 bytes)
  9125                              <1> 	;  ecx = ASCIIZ buffer size (64 or 128)

  9129                              <1> 	; Output:
  9130                              <1> 	;  ecx = remain bytes in buffer
  9131                              <1> 	;	  (after the last zero)
  9132                              <1> 	;   al = the last char converted
  9133                              <1> 	;  edi = next byte position
  9134                              <1> 	;	  in ASCIIZ string/name buffer
  9135                              <1> 	;

  9137                              <1> 	;

  9140                              <1> 	;	ASCIIZ string will be done
  9141                              <1> 	;	by puting a NUL/ZERO at
  9142                              <1> 	;	65th or 129th char position.
  9143                              <1> 	;	(by the caller procedure)
  9144                              <1> 	;    EDI points to that.
  9145                              <1> 	;     AL contains the last character

  9156                              <1> 	;	in TRDOS 386 version 2.1
  9157                              <1> 	; the unicode char will be searched in a table
  9158                              <1> 	; ((which will be prepared by using indexes
  9159                              <1> 	;	0 to 127 for ascii chars 128 to 255))

 11598                              <1> search_fs_shortname:
 11599                              <1> 	; Search short file/dir name in current directory
 11600                              <1> 	; ! (singlix fs) !
 11601                              <1> 	;
 11602                              <1> 	; Input:
 11603                              <1> 	;   esi = ASCIIZ (dos 8.3 dot) file name address
 11604                              <1> 	;	  -In fact: Max. 12 bytes + NUL-

 11618                              <1> 	;

 11626                              <1> 	;    lw = time (16 bits) -HHHHHMMMMMMSSSSS-

 11875                              <1> get_fs_direntry:
 11876                              <1> 	; Get Singlix FS directory entry (by index)
 11877                              <1> 	;
 11878                              <1> 	; INPUT:
 11879                              <1> 	;	eax = directory description table addr
 11880                              <1> 	;	ebx = dir entry index number (< 66536)
 11881                              <1> 	;	      (for all of the directory)
 11882                              <1> 	;	edx = Logical DOS Desc. Table Addr
 11883                              <1> 	;
 11884                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
 11885                              <1> 	;	eax = 0 -> not found or
 11886                              <1> 	;		   end of directory
 11887                              <1> 	;	eax > 0 -> found (FST/DDT number)
 11888                              <1> 	;	ebx = directory entry index number
 11889                              <1> 	;	esi = FDT or DDT buffer address
 11890                              <1> 	;
 11891                              <1> 	;	edx = LDRVT address
 11892                              <1> 	;
 11893                              <1> 	;    If cf = 1 -> Error code in EAX
 11894                              <1> 	;

 11896                              <1> 	;	eax, ebx, ecx, esi, edi, ebp
 11897                              <1> 	;
 11898                              <1> 
 11899 0000CE76 A3[45AE0100]        <1> 	mov	[FS_Current_DDT], eax
 11900 0000CE7B 891D[31AE0100]      <1> 	mov	[FS_Dir_Index], ebx
 11901                              <1> 
 11902 0000CE81 BB00000700          <1> 	mov	ebx, FS_DDT_BUFFER
 11903                              <1> 			; DDT buffer for fast search
 11904 0000CE86 03426C              <1> 	add	eax, [edx+LD_FS_BeginSector]

 11906                              <1>

 11910 0000CE91 5A                  <1> 	pop	edx

 11912                              <1>

 11954                              <1> get_fs_direntry_next:
 11955                              <1> 	; Singlix FS
 11956                              <1> 	; Get next directory entry
 11957                              <1> 	;    (is used just after 'get_fs_direntry')
 11958                              <1> 	;
 11959                              <1> 	; INPUT:
 11960                              <1> 	;	[FS_Dir_Index] = current entry
 11961                              <1> 	;	[FS_CurrentSector] = current sector
 11962                              <1> 	;	[FS_Consequtive] = remaining sectors
 11963                              <1> 	;			in current extent
 11964                              <1> 	;	edx = Logical DOS Desc. Table Addr
 11965                              <1> 	;
 11966                              <1> 	;	FS_DDT_BUFFER ; esi
 11967                              <1> 	;	FS_DIR_BUFFER ; esi
 11968                              <1> 	;	FS_FDT_BUFFER ; esi
 11969                              <1> 	;
 11970                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
 11971                              <1> 	;	eax = 0 -> not found or
 11972                              <1> 	;		   end of directory

 12362                              <1> 	; 25/06/2025
 12363                              <1> 	; 24/06/2025

 12365                              <1> 	; 22/06/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
 12366                              <1> 	;
 12367                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
 12368                              <1> 	;	ESI = ASCIIZ Directory String Address
 12369                              <1> 	;	AL = Current Directory Level
 12370                              <1> 	;	EDI = Destination Adress
 12371                              <1> 	;	     (8 sub dir levels, each one 12+4 bytes)
 12372                              <1> 	;	EBX = start directory number (DDT address)
 12373                              <1> 	;	    = 0 -> root directory
 12374                              <1> 	;	    > 0 -> [Current_Dir_FCluster]

 12378                              <1> 	;

 12381                              <1> 	;	     with zero cluster pointer at the last level
 12382                              <1> 	;	AH = The Last Dir Level
 12383                              <1> 	;
 12384                              <1> 	;	EBX = DDT address of the last dir of the path
 12385                              <1> 	;	If CF = 1 -> AL = error code 
 12386                              <1> 	;

 12694                              <1> 	; 23/06/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
 12695                              <1> search_fs_longname:
 12696                              <1> 	; Search long file/dir name in current directory
 12697                              <1> 	; ! (singlix fs) !
 12698                              <1> 	;
 12699                              <1> 	; Input:
 12700                              <1> 	;   esi = ASCIIZ (or 64 bytes) file name to be
 12701                              <1> 	;	  searched in the (current) directory
 12702                              <1> 	;;  [Current_Drv] = Logical Dos Drive Number
 12703                              <1> 	;   ebx = DDT number of the directory
 12704                              <1> 	;	  	which the name will be searched
 12705                              <1> 	;;;;[Current_Dir_FCluster] = DDT num of the dir
 12706                              <1> 	;		which the name will be searched
 12707                              <1> 	;	          = 0 -> root directory
 12708                              <1> 	;   24/06/2025
 12709                              <1> 	;   [Current_LDRVT] = Logical DOS Drv. D. Table addr
 12710                              <1> 	;
 12711                              <1> 	; Output:
 12712                              <1> 	;   eax = file size
 12713                              <1> 	;    bh = 5th byte of file size
 12714                              <1> 	;    bl = attributes (FDT.Attributes)
 12715                              <1> 	;
 12716                              <1> 	;   ecx = date & time in MSDOS Dir Entry format
 12717                              <1> 	;    lw = time (16 bits) -HHHHHMMMMMMSSSSS-
 12718                              <1> 	;    hw = date (16 bits) -YYYYYYYMMMMDDDDD-
 12719                              <1> 	;
 12720                              <1> 	;   edx = Logical Dos Drive parameters Table
 12721                              <1> 	;   esi = ASCIIZ file/directory name (short name)
 12722                              <1> 	;	 (Max. 12 bytes + NUL, capitalized)
 12723                              <1> 	;
 12724                              <1> 	;    (diff. than msdos: basis name may be 12 bytes)
 12725                              <1> 	;	((msdos basis name limit: 8 bytes))
 12726                              <1> 	;	(see: 'convert_name_from_trfs' procedure)
 12727                              <1> 	;
 12728                              <1> 	;   edi = FDT/DDT buffer address
 12729                              <1> 	;
 12730                              <1> 	;   If CF = 1 -> error code in EAX
 12731                              <1> 	;
 12732                              <1> 	; Modified registers:
 12733                              <1> 	;	eax, ebx, ecx, edx, esi, edi, ebp
 12734                              <1> 	;
 12735                              <1> 
 12736                              <1> 	;mov	[FS_Current_DDT], ebx ; [DIR_FCluster]
 12737 0000D153 8B15[4F9B0100]      <1> 	mov	edx, [Current_LDRVT]
 12738                              <1> search_fs_longname_@:
 12739                              <1> 	; edx = LDRVT address
 12740                              <1> 	; [FS_Current_DDT] = directory description table addr
 12741                              <1> 
 12742 0000D159 8935[4DAE0100]      <1> 	mov	[f_target], esi ; save string address
 12743                              <1> 
 12744                              <1> 	;xor	edx, edx
 12745                              <1> 	;mov	dh, [Current_Drv]
 12746                              <1> 	;add	edx, Logical_DOSDisks
 12747                              <1> 	; 24/06/2025
 12748                              <1> 	;mov	edx, [Current_LDRVT]
 12749                              <1> 
 12750                              <1> 	;mov	ebx, [FS_Current_DDT]
 12751                              <1> 
 12752 0000D15F 31C0                <1> 	xor	eax, eax ; 0
 12753                              <1> 
 12754 0000D161 09DB                <1> 	or	ebx, ebx ; root ?
 12755 0000D163 7509                <1> 	jnz	short sfsln_1
 12756                              <1> 
 12757                              <1> 	; Singlix FS root directory descriptor table
 12758 0000D165 8B5A08              <1> 	mov	ebx, [edx+LD_FS_RootDirD]

 12760                              <1> sfsln_1:

 12896                              <1> get_fs_longname:
 12897                              <1> 	; Get file/dir name in current directory
 12898                              <1> 	; ! (singlix fs) !

 12900                              <1> 	; Input:

 12907                              <1> 	;

    16                              <1> 	; 04/05/2025 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.10)
    17                              <1> 	;	    -PCDOS/MSDOS style FAT fs handling-
    18                              <1> 	;	    ((Ref: RetroDOS v5, 'ibmdos7.s'))
    19                              <1> 	; 07/08/2022

    24                              <1> 	; 05/07/2011
    25                              <1> 	; 07/07/2009
    26                              <1> 	; 2005
    27                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
    28                              <1> 	;	EAX = Cluster Number (32 bit)
    29                              <1> 	;	ESI = Logical DOS Drive Parameters Table
    30                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
    31                              <1> 	;	cf = 0 -> No Error, EAX valid
    32                              <1> 	;	cf = 1 & EAX = 0 -> End Of Cluster Chain
    33                              <1> 	;	cf = 1 & EAX > 0 -> Error
    34                              <1> 	;	ECX = Current/Previous cluster (if CF = 0)
    35                              <1> 	;	EAX = Next Cluster Number (32 bit)
    36                              <1> 	;
    37                              <1> 	; 	EDX = ESI = Logical DOS Drive Parameters Table
    38                              <1> 	;

  1721                              <1> calculate_fat_freespace:
  1722                              <1> 	; 25/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  1723                              <1> 	; 23/03/2016
  1724                              <1> 	; 02/03/2016
  1725                              <1> 	; 01/03/2016
  1726                              <1> 	; 29/02/2016
  1727                              <1> 	; 22/02/2016 (TRDOS 386 = TRDOS v2.0)
  1728                              <1> 	; 30/04/2011
  1729                              <1> 	; 03/04/2010
  1730                              <1> 	; 2005
  1731                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  1732                              <1> 	;	EAX = Cluster count to be added or subtracted
  1733                              <1> 	; 	If BH = FFh, ESI = TR-DOS Logical Drive Description Table
  1734                              <1> 	; 	If BH < FFh, BH = TR-DOS Logical Drive Number
  1735                              <1> 	; 	BL: 
  1736                              <1> 	;	0 = Calculate, 1 = Add, 2 = Subtract, 3 = Get (Not Set/Calc)
  1737                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  1738                              <1> 	;	EAX = Free Space in sectors
  1739                              <1> 	;	ESI = Logical Dos Drive Description Table address
  1740                              <1> 	;	BH = Logical Dos Drive Number (same with input value of BH)
  1741                              <1> 	;	BL = Type of operation (same with input value of BL)
  1742                              <1> 	;	ECX = 0 -> valid
  1743                              <1> 	;	ECX > 0 -> error or invalid
  1744                              <1> 	;	If EAX = FFFFFFFFh, it is 're-calculation needed'
  1745                              <1> 	;			          sign due to r/w error
  1746                              <1> 	;
  1747                              <1> 	; (Modifed registers: eax, ebx, ecx, edx, esi)
  1748                              <1> 	;
  1749                              <1> 
  1750                              <1> 	mov	[CFS_OPType], bx
  1751                              <1> 	mov	[CFS_CC], eax
  1752                              <1> 
  1753                              <1> 	cmp	bh, 0FFh
  1754                              <1> 	je	short pass_calculate_freespace_get_drive_dt_offset
  1755                              <1> 
  1756                              <1> loc_calculate_freespace_get_drive_dt_offset:
  1757                              <1> 	xor	eax, eax
  1758                              <1>         mov     ah, bh
  1759                              <1> 	mov	esi, Logical_DOSDisks
  1760                              <1>         add     esi, eax
  1761                              <1> 
  1762                              <1> pass_calculate_freespace_get_drive_dt_offset:

  1764                              <1> 	jz	short loc_reset_fcc
  1765                              <1>

  1773                              <1>

  3166                              <1> 	;	esi = 11 chars DirEntry format name with possible '?'
  3167                              <1> 	;	edi = 11 chars DirEntry format name, no '?'

  3170                              <1> 	;	Zero if match else NZ
  3171                              <1> 	;

  3173                              <1> 	;	ecx, esi, edi
  3174                              <1> 
  3175 0000D683 B90B000000          <1> 	mov	ecx, 11
  3176                              <1> WildCrd:
  3177 0000D688 F3A6                <1> 	repe	cmpsb
  3178 0000D68A 7406                <1> 	jz	short MetaRet 	; most of the time we will fail.
  3179                              <1> 
  3180 0000D68C 807EFF3F            <1> 	cmp	byte [esi-1], "?"
  3181 0000D690 74F6                <1> 	je	short WildCrd
  3182                              <1> MetaRet:

  3190                              <1> UNPACK:
  3191                              <1> 	; 27/04/2025
  3192                              <1> 	; (MSDOS -> UNPACK) - Ref: Retro DOS v5 - ibmdos7.s
  3193                              <1> 	; Unpack FAT entries (get next cluster)
  3194                              <1> 	;
  3195                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  3196                              <1> 	;	edx = Logical DOS Drive Description Table address
  3197                              <1> 	;	eax = Cluster Number (28bit for FAT32 fs)
  3198                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  3199                              <1> 	;	eax = Content of FAT for given cluster
  3200                              <1> 	;	      (next/new cluster number)
  3201                              <1> 	;	esi = Start of the buffer (buffer header address)
  3202                              <1> 	;	ebx = buffer offset (not used)
  3203                              <1> 	;
  3204                              <1> 	;	Note: if EAX input is 0
  3205                              <1> 	;		EAX = [CL0FATENTRY]
  3206                              <1> 	;	if ZF = 1, EAX output = 0 (Free Cluster)
  3207                              <1> 	;
  3208                              <1> 	; Modified registers:
  3209                              <1> 	;	eax, ecx, ebx, esi, edi, ebp
  3210                              <1> 
  3211 0000D693 21C0                <1> 	and	eax, eax
  3212 0000D695 7516                <1> 	jnz	short up_1
  3213                              <1> 
  3214 0000D697 A1[A0AD0100]        <1> 	mov	eax, [CL0FATENTRY]
  3215 0000D69C 09C0                <1> 	or	eax, eax
  3216 0000D69E C3                  <1> 	retn
  3217                              <1> 
  3218                              <1> up_0:
  3219 0000D69F C74274FFFFFFFF      <1> 	mov	dword [edx+LD_FreeSectors], -1 ; invalid free sectors
  3220 0000D6A6 B823000000          <1> 	mov	eax, ERR_CLUSTER ; 'cluster not available !'
  3221 0000D6AB F9                  <1> 	stc
  3222 0000D6AC C3                  <1> 	retn
  3223                              <1> 
  3224                              <1> up_1:
  3225 0000D6AD 8B4A78              <1> 	mov	ecx, [edx+LD_Clusters] ; Last Cluster number - 1
  3226 0000D6B0 41                  <1> 	inc	ecx	; Last Cluster number
  3227 0000D6B1 39C8                <1> 	cmp	eax, ecx
  3228 0000D6B3 77EA                <1> 	ja	short up_0  ; (MSDOS -> 'HURTFAT:')
  3229                              <1> 
  3230                              <1> 	;call	MAPCLUSTER
  3231                              <1> 	;; if cf = 1 -> eax  = error code
  3232                              <1> 	;; if eax = 0 -> zf = 1
  3233                              <1> 	;retn
  3234                              <1> 
  3235                              <1> 	;jmp	short MAPCLUSTER

  3241                              <1> MAPCLUSTER:
  3242                              <1> 	; 25/11/2025
  3243                              <1> 	; 22/07/2025
  3244                              <1> 	; 10/07/2025
  3245                              <1> 	; 27/04/2025
  3246                              <1> 	; (MSDOS -> MAPCLUSTER) - Ref: Retro DOS v5 - ibmdos7.s
  3247                              <1> 	; Buffer a FAT sector
  3248                              <1> 	;
  3249                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  3250                              <1> 	;	edx = Logical DOS Drive Description Table address
  3251                              <1> 	;	eax = Cluster Number (28bit for FAT32 fs)
  3252                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  3253                              <1> 	;	eax = Content of FAT for given cluster
  3254                              <1> 	;	      (next/new cluster number)
  3255                              <1> 	;	esi = Start of the (FAT) buffer
  3256                              <1> 	;	ebx = buffer offset (not used)
  3257                              <1> 	;	22/07/2025
  3258                              <1> 	;	[ClusSave] = cluster data (16 bit or 32 bit)
  3259                              <1> 	;	10/07/2025
  3260                              <1> 	;	[CLUSNUM] = eax input

  3262                              <1> 	;	[ClusSave], [ClusSec], [ClusSplit]
  3263                              <1> 	;
  3264                              <1> 	;	If CF = 0 and ZF = 1 (EAX = 0) -> Free Cluster
  3265                              <1> 	;
  3266                              <1> 	; Modified registers:
  3267                              <1> 	;	eax, ecx, ebx, esi, edi, ebp
  3268                              <1>

  3270                              <1>

  3272 0000D6BE 7711                <1> 	ja	short mapcl_2	; FAT32
  3273                              <1> 
  3274 0000D6C0 C605[BDAD0100]00    <1> 	mov	byte [ClusSplit], 0
  3275 0000D6C7 89C3                <1> 	mov	ebx, eax
  3276                              <1> 
  3277 0000D6C9 7402                <1> 	je	short mapcl_1	; FAT16
  3278                              <1> 
  3279                              <1> 	; FAT12
  3280 0000D6CB D1E8                <1> 	shr	eax, 1
  3281                              <1> mapcl_1:
  3282 0000D6CD 01D8                <1> 	add	eax, ebx  ; eax = 2 * cluster number (for FAT16)
  3283                              <1> 			  ;     = 1.5 * cluster number (for FAT12)
  3284 0000D6CF EB03                <1> 	jmp	short mapcl_3
  3285                              <1> mapcl_2:	
  3286 0000D6D1 C1E002              <1> 	shl	eax, 2
  3287                              <1> 	; eax = 4 * cluster number (for FAT32)
  3288                              <1> mapcl_3:
  3289                              <1> 	; 512 bytes per sector
  3290                              <1> 	; 9 bit shift to right
  3291                              <1>

  3293 0000D6D6 C1E809              <1> 	shr	eax, 9
  3294 0000D6D9 81E3FF010000        <1> 	and	ebx, 511 ; 1FFh
  3295                              <1>

  3297                              <1> 	; ebx = cluster number offset in the FAT sector
  3298                              <1> 
  3299 0000D6DF 8A4A02              <1> 	mov	cl, [edx+LD_PhyDrvNo]
  3300                              <1>

  3305                              <1>

  3308                              <1> 	;  cl = physical drive number
  3309                              <1>

  3312                              <1>

  3318 0000D6FC 7541                <1> 	jne	short mapcl_4

  3321                              <1>

  3324                              <1> 
  3325 0000D705 FE05[BDAD0100]      <1> 	inc	byte [ClusSplit]
  3326                              <1>

  3333 0000D713 40                  <1> 	inc	eax
  3334                              <1> 
  3335 0000D714 E82CFEFFFF          <1> 	call	GETFATBUFFER
  3336 0000D719 7238                <1> 	jc	short mapcl_5	; eax = error code
  3337                              <1> 
  3338                              <1> 	;mov	al, [ClusSave]

  3341 0000D71B 8D7E18              <1> 	lea	edi, [esi+BUFINSIZ]

  3343                              <1> 	; 25/11/2025

  3345 0000D720 C1E008              <1> 	shl	eax, 8
  3346 0000D723 A0[B0AD0100]        <1> 	mov	al, [ClusSave]
  3347 0000D728 A3[B0AD0100]        <1> 	mov	[ClusSave], eax

  3353 0000D734 7403                <1> 	jz	short mapcl_8 ; no, even

  4171                              <1> 	; 12/05/2025

  4173                              <1> 	; (MSDOS -> DOS_SEARCH_FIRST) - Ref: Retro DOS v5 - ibmdos7.s
  4174                              <1> 	;
  4175                              <1> 	; Initiate a search for the given file spec
  4176                              <1> 	;
  4177                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  4178                              <1> 	;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string 
  4179                              <1> 	;	   ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL terminated)
  4180                              <1> 	;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
  4181                              <1> 	;	   ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
  4182                              <1> 	;	   Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
  4183                              <1> 	;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
  4184                              <1> 	;	   (Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
  4185                              <1> 	;	[SATTRIB] is attribute of search,
  4186                              <1> 	;		  determines what files can be found
  4187                              <1> 	;	FINDFILE_BUFFER is FFF destination buffer
  4188                              <1> 	;
  4189                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  4190                              <1> 	;	FINDFILE_BUFFER is filled
  4191                              <1> 	;
  4192                              <1> 	;	12/05/2025 - temporary
  4193                              <1> 	;	CARRY CLEAR
  4194                              <1> 	;	The 57 bytes of FINDFILE_BUFFER are filled in as follows:
  4195                              <1> 	;
  4196                              <1> 	;	  Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...)
  4197                              <1> 	;	  11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
  4198                              <1> 	;	  Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
  4199                              <1> 	;	  DWORD LastEnt value

  4201                              <1> 	;	  4 byte pad
  4202                              <1> 	;	  32 bytes of the directory entry found
  4203                              <1> 	;
  4204                              <1> 	;	if cf = 1 -> EAX = error code
  4205                              <1> 	;
  4206                              <1> 	; Modified registers:
  4207                              <1> 	;	EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, EBP
  4208                              <1>

  4268                              <1> 
  4269                              <1> ; 11/05/2025 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.10
  4270                              <1> 
  4271                              <1> GETPATH:
  4272                              <1> 	; 05/06/2025
  4273                              <1> 	; 11/05/2025
  4274                              <1> 	; (MSDOS -> GETPATH) - Ref: Retro DOS v5 - ibmdos7.s
  4275                              <1> 	;
  4276                              <1> 	; Parse a WFP (crack the path)
  4277                              <1> 	;
  4278                              <1> 	; INPUT:
  4279                              <1> 	;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string 
  4280                              <1> 	;	   ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL terminated)
  4281                              <1> 	;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
  4282                              <1> 	;	   ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
  4283                              <1> 	;	   Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
  4284                              <1> 	;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
  4285                              <1> 	;	   (Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
  4286                              <1> 	;	[SATTRIB] is attribute of search,
  4287                              <1> 	;		  determines what files can be found
  4288                              <1> 	;	[NoSetDir] set
  4289                              <1> 	;
  4290                              <1> 	; OUTPUT:
  4291                              <1> 	;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
  4292                              <1> 	;	EDX points to Logical DOS Drive Description Table
  4293                              <1> 	;
  4294                              <1> 	;	if cf = 1 -> ERROR
  4295                              <1> 	;	   ESI points to path element causing failure
  4296                              <1> 	;	   if zf = 1
  4297                              <1> 	;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM] and [CLUSFAC]
  4298                              <1> 	;	        are set up to start a search on the last directory
  4299                              <1> 	;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
  4300                              <1> 	;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
  4301                              <1> 	;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
  4302                              <1> 	;		 [NAME1] is the name.
  4303                              <1> 	;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
  4304                              <1> 	;	   if zf = 0
  4305                              <1> 	;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
  4306                              <1> 	;			or attribute mismatch
