  1727                              <1> ;get_device_number:
  1728                              <1> ;	; 08/10/2016
  1729                              <1> ;	; 07/10/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  1730                              <1> ;	;
  1731                              <1> ;	; This procedure compares name of requested
  1732                              <1> ;	; device with kernel device names and
  1733                              <1> ;	; installable device names. If names match,
  1734                              <1> ;	; the relevant device index (entry) number
  1735                              <1> ;	; will be returned the caller (sysopen)
  1736                              <1> ;	; for the requested device.
  1737                              <1> ;	;
  1738                              <1> ;	; NOTE: Installable device drivers must
  1739                              <1> ;	; be loaded before using 'sysopen'
  1740                              <1> ;	; (opendev) system call.
  1741                              <1> ;	;
  1742                              <1> ;	; INPUT:
  1743                              <1> ;	;    ESI = device name address (ASCIIZ)
  1744                              <1> ;	;         (in kernel's memory space)
  1745                              <1> ;  	;    max name length = 8 without '/dev/')
  1746                              <1> ;	;    Device name will be capitalized 
  1747                              <1> ;	;    and if there is, '/dev/' will be
  1748                              <1> ;	;    removed from name before comparising)
  1749                              <1> ;	;
  1750                              <1> ;	; OUTPUT:
  1751                              <1> ;	;    cf = 0 ->
  1752                              <1> ;	;      EAX (AL) = device entry/index number
  1753                              <1> ;	;    cf = 1 -> device not found (installed)
  1754                              <1> ;	;	       or invalid device name
  1755                              <1> ;	;	       (AL=0)
  1756                              <1> ;	;    device_name = device name address (asciiz)
  1757                              <1> ;	;
  1758                              <1> ;	; Modified registers: EAX, EBX, ESI, EDI
  1759                              <1> ;
  1760                              <1> ;	mov	edi, device_name
  1761                              <1> ;	call 	lodsb_capitalize
  1762                              <1> ;	mov	ah, al
  1763                              <1> ;	cmp	al, '/'
  1764                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_1
  1765                              <1> ;	mov	edi, device_name
  1766                              <1> ;	call 	lodsb_capitalize
  1767                              <1> ;gdn_0:
  1768                              <1> ;	and	al, al ; 0 ?
  1769                              <1> ;	jz	short gdn_err ; null name after '/'
  1770                              <1> ;gdn_1:
  1771                              <1> ;	cmp	al, 'D'
  1772                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_2
  1773                              <1> ;	call 	lodsb_capitalize
  1774                              <1> ;	cmp	al, 'E'
  1775                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_2
  1776                              <1> ;	call 	lodsb_capitalize
  1777                              <1> ;	cmp	al, 'V'
  1778                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_2
  1779                              <1> ;	lodsb
  1780                              <1> ;	cmp	al, '/'
  1781                              <1> ;	je	short gdn_4
  1782                              <1> ;gdn_2:
  1783                              <1> ;	cmp	ah, '/'
  1784                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_5
  1785                              <1> ;gdn_err:
  1786                              <1> ;	; invalid device name or device not found
  1787                              <1> ;	xor	eax, eax ; 0
  1788                              <1> ;	stc
  1789                              <1> ;	retn
  1790                              <1> ;gdn_3:
  1791                              <1> ;	cmp	al, '/'
  1792                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_5
  1793                              <1> ;gdn_4:
  1794                              <1> ;	mov	edi, device_name
  1795                              <1> ;	jmp	short gdn_6
  1796                              <1> ;gdn_5:
  1797                              <1> ;	cmp	al, 0
  1798                              <1> ;	je	short gdn_7
  1799                              <1> ;gdn_6:
  1800                              <1> ;	call	lodsb_capitalize
  1801                              <1> ;	cmp	edi, device_name + 8
  1802                              <1> ;	jb	short gdn_3
  1803                              <1> ;	cmp	al, 0
  1804                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_err
  1805                              <1> ;	cmp	edi, device_name + 1
  1806                              <1> ;	jna	short gdn_err ; null name after '/'
  1807                              <1> ;gdn_7:
  1808                              <1> ;	stosb
  1809                              <1> ;	; zero padding ("NAME",0,0,0,0)
  1810                              <1> ;	cmp	edi, device_name + 8
  1811                              <1> ;	jb	short gdn_7
  1812                              <1> ;gdn_8:
  1813                              <1> ;	; search for kernel device names
  1814                              <1> ;	mov	esi, device_name
  1815                              <1> ;	mov	edi, KDEV_NAME
  1816                              <1> ;	xor	eax, eax
  1817                              <1> ;gdn_9:
  1818                              <1> ;	cmpsd
  1819                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_10
  1820                              <1> ;	cmpsd
  1821                              <1> ;	jne	short gdn_11
  1822                              <1> ;	jmp	short gdn_17 ; match
  1823                              <1> ;gdn_10:

  1841                              <1> ;gdn_14:

  1847                              <1> ;	jb	short gdn_13

  1868                              <1> ;

  1870                              <1> ;	; (remain open work will be easy after that)

  1882                              <1> ;

  1931                              <1> ;	; Complete device opening work for sysopen (device)
  1932                              <1> ;	;

  1934                              <1> ;	;	EAX = Device Number (AL)

  2046                              <1> sysaudio: ; AUDIO FUNCTIONS
  2047                              <1> 	; 28/01/2025
  2048                              <1> 	; 27/01/2025
  2049                              <1> 	; 15/01/2025
  2050                              <1> 	; 12/01/2025
  2051                              <1> 	; 11/01/2025 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.10)
  2052                              <1> 	; 29/12/2024
  2053                              <1> 	; 19/12/2024
  2054                              <1> 	; 23/08/2024 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.9)
  2055                              <1> 	; 05/06/2024
  2056                              <1> 	; 04/06/2024
  2057                              <1> 	; 23/05/2024 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.8)
  2058                              <1>  	; 19/11/2023 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.7)
  2059                              <1> 	; 29/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.5)
  2060                              <1> 	; 12/02/2021 (TRDOS 386 v2.0.3)
  2061                              <1> 	; 28/07/2020
  2062                              <1> 	; 27/07/2020
  2063                              <1> 	; 10/10/2017
  2064                              <1> 	; 22/06/2017
  2065                              <1> 	; 28/05/2017, 04/06/2017, 05/06/2017, 10/06/2017
  2066                              <1> 	; 01/05/2017, 12/05/2017, 15/05/2017, 20/05/2017
  2067                              <1> 	; 21/04/2017, 22/04/2017, 23/04/2017, 24/04/2017
  2068                              <1> 	; 10/04/2017, 13/04/2017, 14/04/2017, 16/04/2017
  2069                              <1> 	; 03/04/2017 (VIA VT8237R)
  2070                              <1> 	; 01/04/2016 (trdosk6.s -> tdosk8.s)
  2071                              <1> 	; 16/05/2016 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  2072                              <1> 	;
  2073                              <1> 	; Inputs:
  2074                              <1> 	;
  2075                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 -> Beep (PC Speaker)
  2076                              <1> 	;	     BL = Duration Counter (1 for 1/64 second)
  2077                              <1> 	;	     CX = Frequency Divisor (1193180/Frequency)
  2078                              <1> 	;		 (1331 for 886 Hz)
  2079                              <1> 	;
  2080                              <1> 	;	01/04/2017
  2081                              <1> 	;
  2082                              <1> 	; 	BH = 1 -> DETECT (& ENABLE) AUDIO DEVICE
  2083                              <1> 	;	     BL = 0 : PC SPEAKER
  2084                              <1> 	;		  1 : SOUND BLASTER 16
  2085                              <1> 	;		  2 : INTEL AC'97
  2086                              <1> 	;		  3 : VIA VT8237R (VT8233)
  2087                              <1> 	;		  4 : INTEL HDA
  2088                              <1> 	;	      5-FEh : unknown/invalid
  2089                              <1> 	;	        ; 04/06/2017
  2090                              <1> 	;		FFh : Get current audio device id
  2091                              <1> 	;
  2092                              <1> 	; 	BH = 2 -> ALLOCATE AUDIO BUFFER (for user)
  2093                              <1> 	;		ECX = Audio Buffer Size (must be equal to
  2094                              <1> 	;		      the half of DMA buffer size)
  2095                              <1> 	;		EDX = Virtual Address of the buffer
  2096                              <1> 	;		      (This is not DMA buffer!)
  2097                              <1> 	;
  2098                              <1> 	;	BH = 3 -> INITIALIZE AUDIO DEVICE
  2099                              <1> 	;	     BL = 0,2 -> for Signal Response Byte

  3763                              <1> sound_update:
  3764                              <1> 	; FUNCTION = 16
  3765                              <1> 	; bl =
  3766                              <1> 	;    0 = automatic (sequental) update (with flag switch!)
  3767                              <1> 	;    1 = update dma half buffer 1 (without flag switch!)
  3768                              <1> 	;    2 = update dma half buffer 2 (without flag switch!)
  3769                              <1> 	;  FFh = get current flag value
  3770                              <1> 	;      0 = dma half buffer 1 (will be played next)
  3771                              <1> 	;      1 = dma half buffer 2 (will be played next)
  3772                              <1> 	;
  3773                              <1> 	; 29/12/2024
  3774                              <1> 	; Note:	Requested half buffer is updated and
  3775                              <1> 	;	flag is set to other value for other half buffer
  3776                              <1> 	;
  3777                              <1> 	; For example:
  3778                              <1> 	;     *	if BL input is 1, half buffer 1 is loaded and
  3779                              <1> 	;	   flag is switched to 1 -half buff 2 is in order-
  3780                              <1> 	;     (next time half buffer 2 is updated automaticly)
  3781                              <1> 	;     *	if BL input is 2, half buffer 2 is updated/loaded
  3782                              <1> 	;	   and flag is switched to 0
  3783                              <1> 	;
  3784                              <1> 	; Return value for BL input = 0,1,2
  3785                              <1>  	;     Current flag value (just after switched)
  3786                              <1> 	;       -flag will have same value-
  3787                              <1> 	;     If BL input is 1, return value will be 1 (1 xor 0)
  3788                              <1> 	;     IF BL input is 2, return value will be 0 (1 xor 1)
  3789                              <1> 
  3790                              <1> 	; 28/12/2024
  3791                              <1> 	; 05/06/2024

  3960                              <1> set_irq_callback_service:
  3961                              <1> 	; 23/11/2023
  3962                              <1> 	; 20/11/2023 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.7)
  3963                              <1> 	; 30/07/2022 (TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5)
  3964                              <1> 	; 03/08/2020
  3965                              <1> 	; 10/06/2017
  3966                              <1> 	; 12/05/2017
  3967                              <1> 	; 24/04/2017
  3968                              <1> 	; 22/04/2017
  3969                              <1> 	; caller: 'syscalbac' or 'sysaudio' or ...
  3970                              <1> 	; 13/04/2017, 14/04/2017, 17/04/2017
  3971                              <1> 	; 24/02/2017, 26/02/2017, 28/02/2017
  3972                              <1> 	; 21/02/2017 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  3973                              <1> 	;
  3974                              <1> 	; Link or unlink IRQ callback service to/from user (ring 3)
  3975                              <1> 	;
  3976                              <1> 	; INPUT ->
  3977                              <1> 	;	If AL = 0, the caller is 'syscalbac';
  3978                              <1> 	;	   otherwise, the caller is 'sysaudio' or ...
  3979                              <1> 	;	   (AL = user number)
  3980                              <1> 	;
  3981                              <1> 	;	BL = IRQ number (Hardware interrupt request number)
  3982                              <1> 	;	     (0 to 15 but IRQ 0,1,2,6,8,14,15 are prohibited)
  3983                              <1> 	;	     IRQ numbers 3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13 are valid
  3984                              <1> 	;	     (numbers >15 are invalid)
  3985                              <1> 	;
  3986                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 = Unlink IRQ (in BL) from user (ring 3) service
  3987                              <1> 	;	     1 = Link IRQ by using Signal Response Byte method
  3988                              <1> 	;	     2 = Link IRQ by using Callback service method
  3989                              <1> 	;	     3 = Link IRQ by using Auto Increment S.R.B. method
  3990                              <1> 	;	    >3 = invalid
  3991                              <1> 	;		 (syscallback version will return to user)
  3992                              <1> 	;
  3993                              <1> 	;	CL = Signal Return/Response Byte value
  3994                              <1> 	;
  3995                              <1> 	;	If BH = 3, kernel will put a counter value ; 03/08/2020
  3996                              <1> 	;	          (into the S.R.B. addr)
  3997                              <1> 	;		  between 0 to 255. (start value = CL+1)
  3998                              <1> 	;
  3999                              <1> 	;	NOTE: counter value, for example: even and odd numbers
  4000                              <1> 	;	      may be used for -audio- DMA buffer switch
  4001                              <1> 	;	      within double buffer method, etc.
  4002                              <1> 	;
  4003                              <1> 	;	EDX = Signal return (Response) byte address
  4004                              <1> 	;	       		  - or -
  4005                              <1> 	;	      Interrupt/Callback service/routine address
  4006                              <1> 	;
  4007                              <1> 	;	      (virtual address in user's memory space)
  4008                              <1> 	;
  4009                              <1> 	; OUTPUT ->
  4010                              <1> 	;	CF = 0 & EAX = 0 -> Successful setting
  4011                              <1> 	;	CF = 1 & EAX > 0 -> IRQ is prohibited or locked
  4012                              <1> 	;			by another process
  4013                              <1> 	;		 eax = ERR_PERM_DENIED -> prohibited or locked
  4014                              <1> 	;		 eax = ERR_INV_PARAMETER ->
  4015                              <1> 	;		       invalid parameter/option or bad address
  4016                              <1> 	;
  4017                              <1> 	; TRDOS 386 - IRQ CALLBACK structures (parameters):
  4018                              <1> 	;
  4019                              <1> 	;	   [u.irqlock]	: 1 word, IRQ flags (0-15) that indicates
  4020                              <1> 	;			which IRQs are locked by (that) user.
  4021                              <1> 	;		        Lock and unlock (by user) will change
  4022                              <1> 	;			these flags or 'terminate process' (sysexit)
  4023                              <1> 	;			will clear these flags and unlock those IRQs.
  4024                              <1> 	;
  4025                              <1> 	;		   	Bit 0 is for IRQ 0 and Bit 15 is for IRQ 15
  4026                              <1> 	;
  4027                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).owner	: 1 byte, user, [u.uno], 0 = free (unlocked)
  4028                              <1> 	;
  4029                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).method : 1 byte for callback method & status
  4030                              <1> 	;			   0 = Signal Response Byte method
  4031                              <1> 	;			   1 = Callback service method
  4032                              <1> 	;			   >1 = invalid for current 'syscalback'.
  4033                              <1> 	;			or(+) 80h = IRQ is in use by system (ring 0)
  4034                              <1> 	;			            function (audio etc.) or
  4035                              <1> 	;			   	    a device driver.
  4036                              <1> 	;			(system function will ignore the lock/owner)
  4037                              <1> 	;
  4038                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).srb	: 1 byte, Signal Return/Response byte value
  4039                              <1> 	;			  (a fixed value by user or a counter value
  4040                              <1> 	;			 from 0 to 255, which is increased by every
  4041                              <1> 	;			 interrupt just before putting it into
  4042                              <1> 	;			 the Signal Response byte address)
  4043                              <1> 	;			 (This is not used in callback serv method)
  4044                              <1> 	;
  4045                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).addr	: 1 dword
  4046                              <1> 	;			  Signal Response Byte address (physical)
  4047                              <1> 	;			  		-or-
  4048                              <1> 	;			  Callback service address (virtual)
  4049                              <1> 	;
  4050                              <1> 	;	   IRQ(x).dev	: 1 byte
  4051                              <1> 	;			  0 = Default device or kernel function
  4052                              <1> 	;			  		-or-
  4053                              <1> 	;			  1-255 = Assigned device driver number
  4054                              <1> 	;
  4055                              <1> 	;	   (x) = 3,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13
  4056                              <1> 	;
  4057                              <1> 
  4058 00014206 80FB0F              <1> 	cmp	bl, 15

  4223                              <1> sysdma: ; DMA FUNCTIONS
  4224                              <1> 	; 08/08/2022
  4225                              <1> 	; 30/07/2022 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.5
  4226                              <1> 	; 02/09/2017
  4227                              <1> 	; 28/08/2017
  4228                              <1> 	; 20/08/2017 - TRDOS 386 (TRDOS v2.0)
  4229                              <1> 	;
  4230                              <1> 	; Inputs:
  4231                              <1> 	;	BH = 0 -> Allocate DMA buffer
  4232                              <1> 	;	   BL = 0 -> Use the system's default DMA
  4233                              <1> 	;		     (SB16) Buffer
  4234                              <1> 	;	        Buffer Size (max.) = 65536 bytes
  4235                              <1> 	;	   BL > 0 -> Allocate (a new) DMA buffer
  4236                              <1>  	;	   ECX = DMA Buffer Size in bytes (<=128KB)
  4237                              <1> 	;	   EDX = Virtual Address of DMA buffer
  4238                              <1> 	;
  4239                              <1> 	;	BH = 1 -> Initialize (Start) DMA service
  4240                              <1> 	;	     BL, bit 0 to 3 = Channel Number (0 to 7)
  4241                              <1> 	;	     BL, bit 7 = Auto Initialized Mode
  4242                              <1> 	;			(If bit 7 is set)
  4243                              <1> 	;		 bit 6 = Record (read) mode (0= playback)
  4244                              <1> 	;	     ECX = byte count (0 = use dma buffer size)
  4245                              <1> 	;	     EDX = physical buffer address
  4246                              <1> 	;	     	   (0 = use dma buffer -start- address)
  4247                              <1> 	;
  4248                              <1> 	;	BH = 2 -> Get Current DMA Buffer Offset
  4249                              <1> 	;	     BL = DMA channel number
  4250                              <1> 	;
  4251                              <1> 	;	BH = 3 -> Get Current DMA count down value
  4252                              <1> 	;	     BL = DMA channel number (0 tO 7)
  4253                              <1> 	;
  4254                              <1> 	;	BH = 4 -> Get Current DMA channel (in progress)
  4255                              <1> 	;
  4256                              <1> 	;	BH = 5 -> Get System's Default DMA Buffer Address
  4257                              <1> 	;
  4258                              <1> 	;	BH = 6 -> Get Current DMA Buffer Address
  4259                              <1> 	;
  4260                              <1> 	;	BH = 7 -> Stop DMA service
  4261                              <1> 	;
  4262                              <1> 	; Outputs:
  4263                              <1> 	;
  4264                              <1> 	;	For BH = 0 ; Allocate DMA buffer
  4265                              <1> 	;	    EAX = Physical address of DMA buffer
  4266                              <1> 	;	    ECX = Allocated buffer size in bytes
  4267                              <1> 	;		  - page count * 4096 -
  4268                              <1> 	;		  (may be bigger than requested)
  4269                              <1> 	;	    If BL input > 0,
  4270                              <1> 	;	       'sysalloc:' system call will be used with
  4271                              <1>   	;	       EBX (for 'sysalloc') = EDX (for 'sysdma')
  4272                              <1> 	;	       ECX is same, byte count (buffer size)
  4273                              <1> 	;	       EDX = 1024*1024*16 ; 16 MB upper limit
  4274                              <1> 	;	    If BL input = 0,
  4275                              <1> 	;	       Default DMA buffer (SB16 buffer) will be
  4276                              <1> 	;	       checked and if it is free, it's address
  4277                              <1> 	;	       will be returned in EAX and it's size
  4278                              <1> 	;	       will be returned in ECX (as 65536)
  4279                              <1> 	;
  4280                              <1> 	;	    If CF = 1, error code is in EAX
  4281                              <1> 	;	       EAX = -1 ; DMA buffer allocation error!
  4282                              <1> 	;	       EAX = 11 ; 'Permission Denied' error !
  4283                              <1> 	;
  4284                              <1> 	;	       Note: 'sysalloc' error return method
  4285                              <1> 	;		      will be applied if BL input > 0 !
  4286                              <1> 	;
  4287                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 1 ; Initialize (Start) DMA
  4288                              <1> 	;	     EAX = 0 (Successful)
  4289                              <1> 	;	     If CF = 1, error code is in EAX
  4290                              <1> 	;
  4291                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 2 ; Get Current DMA Buffer Offset
  4292                              <1> 	;	     EAX = DMA Buffer Offset (in bytes)
  4293                              <1> 	;	     ;
  4294                              <1> 	;	      AX = DMA buffer offset
  4295                              <1> 	;	     EAX bits 16 to 23 = Page register value
  4296                              <1> 	;
  4297                              <1> 	; 	 For BH = 3 ; Get Current DMA count down value
  4298                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Count down value (remain bytes)
  4299                              <1> 	;
  4300                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 4 ; Get Current DMA channel (in progress)
  4301                              <1> 	;	     EAX = DMA channel number (0 to 7)
  4302                              <1> 	;		AH = 0 if the owner is the caller process
  4303                              <1> 	;		AH > 0 if the dma channel is in use by
  4304                              <1> 	;		       another user/process
  4305                              <1> 	;	     EAX = -1 (0FFFFFFFFh)
  4306                              <1> 	;		    if DMA service is not in use
  4307                              <1> 	;	 	    (stopped or not initialized/started)
  4308                              <1> 	;
  4309                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 5 ; Get System's Default DMA Buff Addr
  4310                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Default DMA Buffer Address (Physical)
  4311                              <1> 	;		 = offset 'sb16_dma_buffer:'
  4312                              <1> 	;	     ECX = Buffer size
  4313                              <1> 	;		 = 65536
  4314                              <1> 	;
  4315                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 6 ; Get Current DMA Buffer Address
  4316                              <1> 	;	     EAX = Current DMA buffer address (Physical)
  4317                              <1> 	;	     ECX = Current DMA buffer size (setting value)
  4318                              <1> 	;	     Note: These values are for current dma channel
  4319                              <1> 	;		   settings for the user/process
  4320                              <1> 	;	     ** For now (for current TRDOS 386 version)
  4321                              <1> 	;		only one user/process can use only one
  4322                              <1> 	;		dma channel & one dma buffer at same time
  4323                              <1> 	;		(no multi tasking on DMA service) !!! **
  4324                              <1> 	;	     (Once, current DMA user must stop it's own DMA
  4325                              <1> 	;	      DMA service, than another user/program 
  4326                              <1> 	;	      can use DMA service with same dma channel
  4327                              <1> 	;	      or with another DMA channel.)
  4328                              <1> 	;
  4329                              <1> 	;	 For BH = 7 ; Stop DMA service (for current user
  4330                              <1> 	;	     and current DMA channel)
  4331                              <1> 	;	     EAX = 0 ; successful
  4332                              <1> 	;	     CF = 1 & EAX > 0 (= -1) -> Error
  4333                              <1> 
  4334 000142C7 80FF07              <1> 	cmp	bh, 7

  4784                              <1> sysstdio: ; STDIN/STDOUT/STDERR functions
  4785                              <1> 	; 18/09/2024
  4786                              <1> 	; 07/09/2024
  4787                              <1> 	;	(STDAUX/STDPRN functions, pre-definions)
  4788                              <1> 	;	(!these functions are not ready!)
  4789                              <1> 	; 24/08/2024
  4790                              <1> 	; 23/08/2024
  4791                              <1> 	; 20/08/2024 - TRDOS 386 Kernel v2.0.9
  4792                              <1> 	;
  4793                              <1> 	; Inputs:
  4794                              <1> 	;	BL = 0 -> read a character on stdin (wait)
  4795                              <1> 	;	BL = 1 -> read a character on stdin (no wait)
  4796                              <1> 	;	BL = 2 -> write a character onto stdout (redirection)
  4797                              <1> 	;	BL = 3 -> write a character onto stderr (no redirection)
  4798                              <1> 	;	BL = 4 -> redirect stdin to file (if cl > 0)
  4799                              <1> 	;	BL = 5 -> redirect stdout to file (if cl > 0)
  4800                              <1> 	;	BL = 6 -> read character (ascii and scancode) on stdin
  4801                              <1> 	;				-no redirection, wait-
  4802                              <1> 	;	BL = 7 -> read character (ascii and scancode) on stdin
  4803                              <1> 	;				-no redirection, no wait-
  4804                              <1> 	;	BL = 8 -> write character and color onto stdout
  4805                              <1> 	;				-no redirection-
  4806                              <1> 	;	BL = 9 -> ungetchar (put back the ascii code in u.getc)
  4807                              <1> 	;
  4808                              <1> 	;	For BL=2,3,8,9
  4809                              <1> 	;	    CL = character (ascii) code
  4810                              <1> 	;	For BL=8
  4811                              <1> 	;	    CH = color (Attribute) -CGA-
  4812                              <1> 	;	For BL=4,5
  4813                              <1> 	;	    CL = file descriptor number + 1
  4814                              <1> 	;	    (File must be open and that number is 'u.fp' index)
  4815                              <1> 	;
  4816                              <1> 	;	07/09/2024 (these subfunctions will not be handled
  4817                              <1> 	;		   by kernel v2.0.9 for now)
  4818                              <1> 	;	 -I am writing them here for C compiler compatibility,
  4819                              <1> 	;	  for now. Ref: SCC STDIO.H-
  4820                              <1> 	;	BL = 10 -> get STDAUX status
  4821                              <1> 	;	BL = 11 -> get/select STDAUX (COM) port
  4822                              <1> 	;				(clears redirection)
  4823                              <1> 	;	BL = 12 -> redirect STDAUX
  4824                              <1> 	;	BL = 13 -> STDAUX IOCTL (control functions)
  4825                              <1> 	;	BL = 14 -> read byte/character from STDAUX
  4826                              <1> 	;	BL = 15 -> write byte/character to STDAUX
  4827                              <1> 	;	BL = 16 -> get STDPRN status (LPT printer only)
  4828                              <1> 	;	BL = 17 -> redirect STDPRN
  4829                              <1> 	;	BL = 18 -> STDPRN IOCTL (init/control functions)
  4830                              <1> 	;	BL = 19 -> write byte/character to STDPRN
  4831                              <1> 	;
  4832                              <1> 	;	For BL = 11
  4833                              <1> 	;	    If	CL = 0 -> get STDAUX (COM) port number
  4834                              <1> 	;		CL = 1 -> COM1
  4835                              <1> 	;		CL = 2 -> COM2
  4836                              <1> 	;		CL > 4 -> invalid
  4837                              <1> 	;	For BL = 12
  4838                              <1> 	;	    If ECX = 0 -> clear redirection
  4839                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 7Fh = 0 -> redirect INPUT
  4840                              <1> 	;	        CH & 7Fh > 0 -> redirect OUTPUT
  4841                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 80h 
  4842                              <1> 	;		CL = file handle (descriptor index)
  4843                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 0
  4844                              <1> 	;		CL = console (pseudo) tty number,
  4845                              <1> 	;		     1 to 8 for tty0 to tty7.
  4846                              <1> 	;	For BL = 13
  4847                              <1> 	;	    If CL = 0 -> get control byte
  4848                              <1> 	;	    If CL > 1 -> set control byte (in CL)
  4849                              <1> 	;		bit 0 = 1
  4850                              <1> 	;		bit 1 = data bits (set=8, clear=7)
  4851                              <1> 	;		bit 2 = stop bit (set=2, clear=1)
  4852                              <1> 	;		bit 3 = parity bit (set=yes, clear=no)
  4853                              <1> 	;		bit 4 = parity bit (set=even, clear=odd)
  4854                              <1> 	;		bit 5-6-7 = data rate
  4855                              <1> 	;			000 = 9600
  4856                              <1> 	;		        001 = 19200
  4857                              <1> 	;			010 = 38400
  4858                              <1> 	;			011 = 57600
  4859                              <1> 	;			100 = 115200
  4860                              <1> 	;	For BL = 15, 19
  4861                              <1> 	;	    CL = byte/character to r/w
  4862                              <1> 	;	For BL = 17
  4863                              <1> 	;	    If ECX = 0 -> clear redirection
  4864                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 80h 
  4865                              <1> 	;		CL = file handle (descriptor index)
  4866                              <1> 	;	    If  CH & 80h = 0
  4867                              <1> 	;		CL = console (pseudo) tty number,
  4868                              <1> 	;		     1 to 8 for tty0 to tty7.
  4869                              <1> 	;	For BL = 18
  4870                              <1> 	;	    If CL = 0 -> initialize printer (command=0)
  4871                              <1> 	;	       CL > 0 -> configuration/command byte
  4872                              <1> 	;			 (reserved, not used)
  4873                              <1> 	;
  4874                              <1> 	; Outputs:
  4875                              <1> 	;
  4876                              <1> 	;	For BL=0,1,2,3,6,7,8,9
  4877                              <1> 	;	    AL = character (ascii) code
  4878                              <1> 	;	For BL=6,7
  4879                              <1> 	;	    AH = scan code
  4880                              <1> 	;	For BL=4,5
  4881                              <1> 	;	    AL = file descriptor (CL input - 1)
  4882                              <1> 	;
  4883                              <1> 	;	If CF=1
  4884                              <1> 	;	   AL (EAX) = error code
  4885                              <1> 	;	   If EAX = 0 -> EOF ; 18/09/2024
  4886                              <1> 	;
  4887                              <1> 	;	07/09/2024
  4888                              <1> 	;	For BL = 10 to 19
  4889                              <1> 	;	    IF CF = 1, EAX/AL = error code
  4890                              <1> 	;    .. If CF = 0 ...
  4891                              <1> 	;	For BL = 10 & 16
  4892                              <1> 	;	    AL (EAX) = status
  4893                              <1> 	;	For BL = 11
  4894                              <1> 	;	    EAX/AL = COM (serial) port (1 to 4)
  4895                              <1> 	;	For BL = 12, 15, 17, 18, 19
  4896                              <1> 	;	    EAX/AL = 0
  4897                              <1> 	;	For BL = 13
  4898                              <1> 	;	    If CL input = 0
  4899                              <1> 	;		  EAX/AL = current ctrl/cfg byte
  4900                              <1> 	;           If CL input > 0
  4901                              <1> 	;		  EAX/AL = ctrl/cfg byte
  4902                              <1> 	;	For BL = 14
  4903                              <1> 	;	    EAX/AL = byte/character
  4904                              <1> 	;
  4905                              <1>

    96                              <1> ; 
    97                              <1> ; DOS filenames include the following:
    98                              <1> ;  UpperCase letters A-Z
    99                              <1> ;  Numbers 0-9
   100                              <1> ;  Space (20h)
   101                              <1> ;  !, #, $, %, &, ', (, ), -, @, ^, _, `, {, }, ~
   102                              <1> ;  Values 128 255
   103                              <1> ;
   104                              <1> ; This excludes the following ASCII characters:
   105                              <1> ;  ", *, +, ,, /, :, ;, <, =, >, ?, \, [, ], |
   106                              <1> ;  . (DOT) within name and extension fields,
   107                              <1> ;			 except in . and .. entries
   108                              <1> ;  Lowercase letters a z, stored as A Z on FAT12/FAT16/FAT32
   109                              <1> ;  Control characters 0 31
   110                              <1> ;  Value 127 (DEL)

   141                              <1> ; < (less than)

   153                              <1> ; 0-31 (ASCII control characters)

   157                              <1> ; CON, PRN, AUX, NUL

   159                              <1> ; LPT1, LPT2, LPT3, LPT4, LPT5, LPT6, LPT7, LPT8, LPT9

    55                              <1> ; bit 31 = 1
    56                              <1> ; bit 23:16 = bus number     (0-255)
    57                              <1> ; bit 15:11 = device number  (0-31)
    58                              <1> ; bit 10:8 = function number (0-7)
    59                              <1> ; bit 7:0 = register number  (0-255)

    64                              <1> PCI32           EQU     BIT31	; bitflag to signal 32bit access
    65                              <1> PCI16           EQU     BIT30	; bitflag for 16bit access

   436                              <1> 	; 10/06/2017
   437                              <1> 	; === Intel ICH I/O Controller Hub Datasheet, Section 8.1.16 ===
   438                              <1> 	; PRQ[n]_ROUT Register (61h, PRQB) Bit 7:
   439                              <1> 	; Interrupt Routing Enable (IRQEN).
   440                              <1> 	; 0 = The corresponding PIRQ is routed to one of the ISA-compatible
   441                              <1> 	;     interrupts specified in bits[3:0].
   442                              <1> 	; 1 = The PIRQ is not routed to the 8259.
   443                              <1> 	; Note: If the PIRQ is intended to cause an interrupt to the ICH’s
   444                              <1> 	;	integrated I/O APIC, then this bit should be set to 0 and
   445                              <1> 	;	the APIC_EN bit should be set to 1. 
   446                              <1> 	;	The IRQEN must be set to 0 and the PIRQ routed to 
   447                              <1> 	;	an 8259 interrupt via the IRQ Routing filed (bits[3:0).
   448                              <1> 	;	The corresponding 8259 interrupt must be masked via the 
   449                              <1> 	;	appropriated bit in the 8259’s OCW1 (Interrupt Mask)
   450                              <1> 	;	register. The IOAPIC must then be enabled by setting 
   451                              <1> 	;	the APIC_EN bit in the GEN_CNTL register.
   452                              <1> 
   453                              <1> 	;mov	eax, 0F861h  ; D31:F0
   454                              <1> 	;	; AL=61h : PIRQ[B] Routing Control Reg, LPC interface
   455                              <1> 	;;mov	dl, [audio_intr]
   456                              <1> 	;call	pciRegWrite8
   457                              <1> 	;;mov	al, 0D0h	; General Control Register (GEN_CTL)
   458                              <1> 	;;call	pciRegRead32

   463                              <1> 	;

   485                              <1> pciFindDevice:
   486                              <1> 	; 19/11/2023
   487                              <1> 	; 03/04/2017 ('pci.asm', 20/03/2017)
   488                              <1> 	;
   489                              <1> 	; scan through PCI space looking for a device+vendor ID
   490                              <1> 	;
   491                              <1> 	; Entry: EAX=Device+Vendor ID
   492                              <1> 	;
   493                              <1> 	; Exit: EAX=PCI address if device found
   494                              <1> 	;	EDX=Device+Vendor ID
   495                              <1> 	;       CY clear if found, set if not found. EAX invalid if CY set.
   496                              <1> 	;
   497                              <1> 	; Destroys: ebx, edi ; 19/11/2023
   498                              <1> 
   499                              <1> 	;push	ecx
   500                              <1> 	;push	eax ; * ; 19/11/2023
   501                              <1> 	;push	esi
   502                              <1> 	;push	edi
   503                              <1> 	;
   504                              <1> 	;mov	esi, eax		; save off vend+device ID
   505                              <1>         ; 19/11/2023
   506 0001546F 89C3                <1> 	mov	ebx, eax
   507                              <1> 	;mov	edi, (80000000h - 100h)	; start with bus 0, dev 0 func 0
   508 00015471 BF00000080          <1> 	mov	edi, 80000000h
   509                              <1> nextPCIdevice:
   510                              <1> 	;add	edi, 100h
   511                              <1> 	;cmp	edi, 80FFF800h		; scanned all devices?
   512                              <1> 	;stc
   513                              <1> 	;je	short PCIScanExit	; not found
   514                              <1> 
   515 00015476 89F8                <1> 	mov 	eax, edi		; read PCI registers
   516 00015478 E87D000000          <1> 	call	pciRegRead32
   517                              <1> 	; 19/11/2023
   518 0001547D 39DA                <1> 	cmp	edx, ebx
   519                              <1> 	;cmp	edx, esi		; found device?
   520                              <1> 	;jne	short nextPCIdevice
   521                              <1> 	;;clc
   522 0001547F 7412                <1> 	je	short PCIScanExit	; found
   523                              <1> 	; 19/11/2023

   545                              <1> %if 1
   546                              <1> 
   547                              <1> pciRegRead:
   548                              <1> 	; 03/04/2017 ('pci.asm', 20/03/2017)
   549                              <1> 	;
   550                              <1> 	; 8/16/32bit PCI reader
   551                              <1> 	;
   552                              <1> 	; Entry: EAX=PCI Bus/Device/fn/register number
   553                              <1> 	;           BIT30 set if 32 bit access requested
   554                              <1> 	;           BIT29 set if 16 bit access requested
   555                              <1> 	;           otherwise defaults to 8 bit read
   556                              <1> 	;
   557                              <1> 	; Exit:  DL,DX,EDX register data depending on requested read size
   558                              <1> 	;
   559                              <1> 	; Note1: this routine is meant to be called via pciRegRead8,
   560                              <1> 	;	 pciRegread16 or pciRegRead32, listed below.
   561                              <1> 	;
   562                              <1> 	; Note2: don't attempt to read 32 bits of data from a non dword
   563                              <1> 	;	 aligned reg number. Likewise, don't do 16 bit reads from
   564                              <1> 	;	 non word aligned reg #
   565                              <1> 	
   566 0001549B 53                  <1> 	push	ebx
   567 0001549C 51                  <1> 	push	ecx
   568 0001549D 89C3                <1>         mov     ebx, eax		; save eax, dh
   569 0001549F 88F1                <1>         mov     cl, dh
   570                              <1> 
   571 000154A1 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; clear out data size request
   572 000154A6 0D00000080          <1>         or      eax, BIT31		; make a PCI access request
   573 000154AB 24FC                <1>         and     al, ~3 ; NOT 3		; force index to be dword
   574                              <1> 
   575 000154AD 66BAF80C            <1>         mov     dx, PCI_INDEX_PORT
   576 000154B1 EF                  <1>         out	dx, eax			; write PCI selector
   577                              <1> 	
   578 000154B2 66BAFC0C            <1>         mov     dx, PCI_DATA_PORT
   579 000154B6 88D8                <1>         mov     al, bl
   580 000154B8 2403                <1>         and     al, 3			; figure out which port to
   581 000154BA 00C2                <1>         add     dl, al			; read to
   582                              <1> 
   583 000154BC F7C3000000C0        <1> 	test    ebx, PCI32+PCI16
   584 000154C2 7507                <1>         jnz     short _pregr0
   585 000154C4 EC                  <1> 	in	al, dx			; return 8 bits of data
   586 000154C5 88C2                <1>         mov	dl, al
   587 000154C7 88CE                <1> 	mov     dh, cl			; restore dh for 8 bit read
   588 000154C9 EB12                <1> 	jmp	short _pregr2
   589                              <1> _pregr0:	
   590 000154CB F7C300000080        <1> 	test    ebx, PCI32
   591 000154D1 7507                <1>         jnz	short _pregr1
   592 000154D3 66ED                <1> 	in	ax, dx
   593 000154D5 6689C2              <1>         mov     dx, ax			; return 16 bits of data
   594 000154D8 EB03                <1> 	jmp	short _pregr2
   595                              <1> _pregr1:
   596 000154DA ED                  <1> 	in	eax, dx			; return 32 bits of data
   597 000154DB 89C2                <1> 	mov	edx, eax
   598                              <1> _pregr2:
   599 000154DD 89D8                <1> 	mov     eax, ebx		; restore eax
   600 000154DF 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; clear out data size request
   601 000154E4 59                  <1> 	pop	ecx
   602 000154E5 5B                  <1> 	pop	ebx
   603 000154E6 C3                  <1> 	retn
   604                              <1> 
   605                              <1> pciRegRead8:
   606 000154E7 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 8 bit read size
   607 000154EC EBAD                <1>         jmp     short pciRegRead	; call generic PCI access
   608                              <1> 
   609                              <1> pciRegRead16:
   610 000154EE 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 16 bit read size
   611 000154F3 0D00000040          <1>         or      eax, PCI16		; call generic PCI access
   612 000154F8 EBA1                <1>         jmp     short pciRegRead
   613                              <1> 
   614                              <1> pciRegRead32:
   615 000154FA 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 32 bit read size
   616 000154FF 0D00000080          <1>         or      eax, PCI32		; call generic PCI access
   617 00015504 EB95                <1>         jmp     pciRegRead
   618                              <1> 
   619                              <1> pciRegWrite:
   620                              <1> 	; 03/04/2017 ('pci.asm', 29/11/2016)
   621                              <1> 	;
   622                              <1> 	; 8/16/32bit PCI writer
   623                              <1> 	;
   624                              <1> 	; Entry: EAX=PCI Bus/Device/fn/register number
   625                              <1> 	;           BIT31 set if 32 bit access requested
   626                              <1> 	;           BIT30 set if 16 bit access requested
   627                              <1> 	;           otherwise defaults to 8bit read
   628                              <1> 	;        DL/DX/EDX data to write depending on size
   629                              <1> 	;
   630                              <1> 	; Note1: this routine is meant to be called via pciRegWrite8, 
   631                              <1> 	;	 pciRegWrite16 or pciRegWrite32 as detailed below.
   632                              <1> 	;
   633                              <1> 	; Note2: don't attempt to write 32bits of data from a non dword
   634                              <1> 	;	 aligned reg number. Likewise, don't do 16 bit writes from
   635                              <1> 	;	 non word aligned reg #
   636                              <1> 
   637 00015506 53                  <1> 	push	ebx
   638 00015507 51                  <1> 	push	ecx
   639 00015508 89C3                <1>         mov     ebx, eax		; save eax, edx
   640 0001550A 89D1                <1>         mov     ecx, edx
   641 0001550C 25FFFFFF3F          <1> 	and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; clear out data size request
   642 00015511 0D00000080          <1>         or      eax, BIT31		; make a PCI access request
   643 00015516 24FC                <1>         and     al, ~3 ; NOT 3		; force index to be dword
   644                              <1> 
   645 00015518 66BAF80C            <1>         mov     dx, PCI_INDEX_PORT
   646 0001551C EF                  <1>         out	dx, eax			; write PCI selector
   647                              <1> 	
   648 0001551D 66BAFC0C            <1>         mov     dx, PCI_DATA_PORT
   649 00015521 88D8                <1>         mov     al, bl
   650 00015523 2403                <1>         and     al, 3			; figure out which port to
   651 00015525 00C2                <1>         add     dl, al			; write to
   652                              <1> 
   653 00015527 F7C3000000C0        <1> 	test    ebx, PCI32+PCI16
   654 0001552D 7505                <1>         jnz     short _pregw0
   655 0001552F 88C8                <1> 	mov	al, cl 			; put data into al
   656 00015531 EE                  <1> 	out	dx, al
   657 00015532 EB12                <1> 	jmp	short _pregw2
   658                              <1> _pregw0:
   659 00015534 F7C300000080        <1> 	test    ebx, PCI32
   660 0001553A 7507                <1>         jnz     short _pregw1
   661 0001553C 6689C8              <1> 	mov	ax, cx			; put data into ax
   662 0001553F 66EF                <1> 	out	dx, ax
   663 00015541 EB03                <1> 	jmp	short _pregw2
   664                              <1> _pregw1:
   665 00015543 89C8                <1> 	mov	eax, ecx		; put data into eax
   666 00015545 EF                  <1> 	out	dx, eax
   667                              <1> _pregw2:
   668 00015546 89D8                <1>         mov     eax, ebx		; restore eax
   669 00015548 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; clear out data size request
   670 0001554D 89CA                <1>         mov     edx, ecx		; restore dx
   671 0001554F 59                  <1> 	pop	ecx
   672 00015550 5B                  <1> 	pop	ebx
   673 00015551 C3                  <1> 	retn
   674                              <1> 
   675                              <1> pciRegWrite8:
   676 00015552 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 8 bit write size
   677 00015557 EBAD                <1>         jmp	short pciRegWrite	; call generic PCI access
   678                              <1> 
   679                              <1> pciRegWrite16:
   680 00015559 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 16 bit write size
   681 0001555E 0D00000040          <1>         or      eax, PCI16		; call generic PCI access
   682 00015563 EBA1                <1>         jmp	short pciRegWrite
   683                              <1> 
   684                              <1> pciRegWrite32:
   685 00015565 25FFFFFF3F          <1>         and     eax, NOT_PCI32_PCI16	; set up 32 bit write size
   686 0001556A 0D00000080          <1>         or      eax, PCI32		; call generic PCI access
   687 0001556F EB95                <1>         jmp	pciRegWrite

   690                              <1> 
   691                              <1> ; 26/11/2023 - temporary
   692                              <1> %if 0
   693                              <1> 
   694                              <1> ; PLAYWAV3.COM, ac97_vra.asm, 19/11/2023, Erdogan Tan
   695                              <1> 
   696                              <1> ;===============================================================
   697                              <1> ; 8/16/32bit PCI reader
   698                              <1> ;
   699                              <1> ; Entry: EAX=PCI Bus/Device/fn/register number
   700                              <1> ;           BIT30 set if 32 bit access requested
   701                              <1> ;           BIT29 set if 16 bit access requested
   702                              <1> ;           otherwise defaults to 8 bit read
   703                              <1> ;
   704                              <1> ; Exit:  DL,DX,EDX register data depending on requested read size
   705                              <1> ;
   706                              <1> ; Note: this routine is meant to be called via pciRegRead8, pciRegread16,
   707                              <1> ;	or pciRegRead32, listed below.
   708                              <1> ;
   709                              <1> ; Note2: don't attempt to read 32bits of data from a non dword aligned reg
   710                              <1> ;	 number. Likewise, don't do 16bit reads from non word aligned reg #
   711                              <1> ; 
   712                              <1> pciRegRead:
   713                              <1> 	push	ebx
   714                              <1> 	push	ecx
   715                              <1>         mov     ebx, eax                        ; save eax, dh
   716                              <1>         mov     cl, dh
   717                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI32)+PCI16             ; clear out data size request
   718                              <1>         or      eax, BIT31                      ; make a PCI access request
   719                              <1>         and     al, ~3 ; NOT 3                  ; force index to be dword
   720                              <1> 
   721                              <1>         mov     dx, PCI_INDEX_PORT
   722                              <1>         out     dx, eax                         ; write PCI selector
   723                              <1> 
   724                              <1>         mov     dx, PCI_DATA_PORT
   725                              <1>         mov     al, bl
   726                              <1>         and     al, 3                           ; figure out which port to
   727                              <1>         add     dl, al                          ; read to
   728                              <1> 
   729                              <1> 	in      eax, dx                         ; do 32bit read
   730                              <1>         test    ebx, PCI32
   731                              <1>         jz      short _pregr1
   732                              <1> 
   733                              <1>         mov     edx, eax                        ; return 32bits of data
   734                              <1> _pregr1:
   735                              <1> 	mov     dx, ax                          ; return 16bits of data
   736                              <1>         test    ebx, PCI32+PCI16
   737                              <1>         jnz     short _pregr2
   738                              <1>         mov     dh, cl                          ; restore dh for 8 bit read
   739                              <1> _pregr2:
   740                              <1>         mov     eax, ebx                        ; restore eax
   741                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI32)+PCI16             ; clear out data size request
   742                              <1> 	pop	ecx
   743                              <1> 	pop	ebx
   744                              <1> 	retn
   745                              <1> 
   746                              <1> pciRegRead8:
   747                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32             ; set up 8 bit read size
   748                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegRead		; call generic PCI access
   749                              <1> 
   750                              <1> pciRegRead16:
   751                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32		; set up 16 bit read size
   752                              <1>         or      eax, PCI16			; call generic PCI access
   753                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegRead
   754                              <1> 
   755                              <1> pciRegRead32:
   756                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32		; set up 32 bit read size
   757                              <1>         or      eax, PCI32			; call generic PCI access
   758                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegRead
   759                              <1> 
   760                              <1> ;===============================================================
   761                              <1> ; 8/16/32bit PCI writer
   762                              <1> ;
   763                              <1> ; Entry: EAX=PCI Bus/Device/fn/register number
   764                              <1> ;           BIT31 set if 32 bit access requested
   765                              <1> ;           BIT30 set if 16 bit access requested
   766                              <1> ;           otherwise defaults to 8bit read
   767                              <1> ;        DL/DX/EDX data to write depending on size
   768                              <1> ;
   769                              <1> ;
   770                              <1> ; note: this routine is meant to be called via pciRegWrite8, pciRegWrite16,
   771                              <1> ; 	or pciRegWrite32 as detailed below.
   772                              <1> ;
   773                              <1> ; Note2: don't attempt to write 32bits of data from a non dword aligned reg
   774                              <1> ;	 number. Likewise, don't do 16bit writes from non word aligned reg #
   775                              <1> ;
   776                              <1> pciRegWrite:
   777                              <1> 	push	ebx
   778                              <1> 	push	ecx
   779                              <1>         mov     ebx, eax                        ; save eax, dx
   780                              <1>         mov     cx, dx
   781                              <1>         or      eax, BIT31                      ; make a PCI access request
   782                              <1>         and     eax, ~PCI16 ; NOT PCI16         ; clear out data size request
   783                              <1>         and     al, ~3 ; NOT 3                  ; force index to be dword
   784                              <1> 
   785                              <1>         mov     dx, PCI_INDEX_PORT
   786                              <1>         out     dx, eax                         ; write PCI selector
   787                              <1> 
   788                              <1>         mov     dx, PCI_DATA_PORT
   789                              <1>         mov     al, bl
   790                              <1>         and     al, 3                           ; figure out which port to
   791                              <1>         add     dl, al                          ; write to
   792                              <1> 
   793                              <1>         mov     eax, edx                        ; put data into eax
   794                              <1>         mov     ax, cx
   795                              <1> 
   796                              <1>         out     dx, al
   797                              <1>         test    ebx, PCI16+PCI32                ; only 8bit access? bail
   798                              <1>         jz      short _pregw1
   799                              <1> 
   800                              <1>         out     dx, ax                          ; write 16 bit value
   801                              <1>         test    ebx, PCI16                      ; 16bit requested?  bail
   802                              <1>         jnz     short _pregw1
   803                              <1> 
   804                              <1>         out     dx, eax                         ; write full 32bit
   805                              <1> _pregw1:
   806                              <1>         mov     eax, ebx                        ; restore eax
   807                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI32)+PCI16             ; clear out data size request
   808                              <1>         mov     dx, cx                          ; restore dx
   809                              <1> 	pop	ecx
   810                              <1> 	pop	ebx
   811                              <1> 	ret
   812                              <1> 
   813                              <1> pciRegWrite8:
   814                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32		; set up 8 bit write size
   815                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegWrite		; call generic PCI access
   816                              <1> 
   817                              <1> pciRegWrite16:
   818                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32		; set up 16 bit write size
   819                              <1>         or      eax, PCI16			; call generic PCI access
   820                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegWrite
   821                              <1> 
   822                              <1> pciRegWrite32:
   823                              <1>         and     eax, (~PCI16)+PCI32		; set up 32 bit write size
   824                              <1>         or      eax, PCI32			; call generic PCI access
   825                              <1>         jmp     short pciRegWrite
   826                              <1> 
   827                              <1> ;===============================================================
   828                              <1> 
   829                              <1> %endif

  1483 000157D3 89C2                <1> 	mov	edx, eax
  1484                              <1> 
  1485                              <1> ; VIA VT8235.PDF: (Page 110) (Erdogan Tan, 29/11/2016)
  1486                              <1> 	;
  1487                              <1> 	; 	Audio SGD Table Format
  1488                              <1> 	;	-------------------------------
  1489                              <1> 	;	63   62    61-56    55-32  31-0
  1490                              <1> 	;	--   --   --------  -----  ----
  1491                              <1> 	;	EOL FLAG -reserved- Base   Base
  1492                              <1> 	;		    	    Count  Address
  1493                              <1> 	;		            [23:0] [31:0]
  1494                              <1> 	;	EOL: End Of Link. 
  1495                              <1> 	;	     1 indicates this block is the last of the link.
  1496                              <1> 	;	     If the channel “Interrupt on EOL” bit is set, then
  1497                              <1> 	;	     an interrupt is generated at the end of the transfer.
  1498                              <1> 	;
  1499                              <1> 	;	FLAG: Block Flag. If set, transfer pauses at the end of this
  1500                              <1> 	;	      block. If the channel “Interrupt on FLAG” bit is set,
  1501                              <1> 	;	      then an interrupt is generated at the end of this block.
  1502                              <1> 
  1503 000157D5 89F0                <1> 	mov	eax, esi ; DMA half buffer size
  1504                              <1> 
  1505                              <1> 		; 04/06/2024 - Erdogan Tan
  1506                              <1> 		; NOTE: I have changed DMA half buffer size to
  1507                              <1> 		; (word aligned) audio buffer size for smooth audio playing
  1508                              <1> 		; (it was page border aligned before June 4, 2024)
  1509                              <1> 		;
  1510                              <1> 		; For example:
  1511                              <1> 		;    For 65416 bytes audio buffer (22kHz, 16bit samples)
  1512                              <1> 		;       (user's audio buff virtual addr is mapped to physical)
  1513                              <1> 		;	((kernel's and user's audio buff pages are same)) 
  1514                              <1> 		;    1) Memory allocation (of it) is 65536 bytes
  1515                              <1> 		;    2) DMA half buffer size is 65416 bytes
  1516                              <1> 		;	(it would be 65536 bytes before this modification)
  1517                              <1> 		;	((additional 140 bytes would cause to a noise))	     
  1518                              <1> 		;    3) Total DMA buffer size is 131072 bytes
  1519                              <1> 		;       (the last 240 bytes will not be used for playing)
  1520                              <1> 
  1521 000157D7 01C2                <1> 	add	edx, eax
  1522 000157D9 0D00000040          <1> 	or	eax, FLAG
  1523                              <1> 	;or	eax, EOL
  1524 000157DE AB                  <1> 	stosd
  1525                              <1> 
  1526                              <1> ; 2nd buffer:
  1527                              <1> 
  1528 000157DF 89D0                <1>         mov	eax, edx ; Physical address of the 2nd half of DMA buffer
  1529 000157E1 AB                  <1> 	stosd		 ; store dmabuffer2 address
  1530                              <1> 
  1531                              <1> ; set length to [audio_dmabuff_size]/2
  1532                              <1> ; Set control (bits 31:16) to BUP, bits 15:0=number of samples
  1533                              <1> ; 
  1534 000157E2 89F0                <1> 	mov	eax, esi ; DMA half buffer size
  1535                              <1> 	; 22/07/2020
  1536                              <1> 	;or	eax, EOL
  1537 000157E4 0D00000040          <1> 	or	eax, FLAG
  1538 000157E9 AB                  <1> 	stosd
  1539                              <1>

  1541                              <1> 
  1542                              <1> 	; 22/07/2020

  1544                              <1>

  3077                              <1> set_ac97_bdl: ; Set AC97 (ICH) Buffer Descriptor List
  3078                              <1> 	; 04/06/2024 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.8
  3079                              <1> 	; 06/08/2022 - TRDOS 386 v2.0.5
  3080                              <1> 	; 17/06/2017
  3081                              <1> 	; 11/06/2017
  3082                              <1> 	; 28/05/2017
  3083                              <1> 	; eax = dma buffer address = [audio_DMA_buff]
  3084                              <1> 	;; ecx = dma buffer buffer size = [audio_dmabuff_size]
  3085                              <1> 
  3086                              <1> 	; 04/06/2024
  3087                              <1> 	; ecx = DMA half buffer size as truncated for 8 byte alignment
  3088                              <1> 
  3089                              <1> 	;shr	ecx, 1 ; dma half buffer size
  3090 00015DF1 89CE                <1> 	mov	esi, ecx
  3091                              <1> 
  3092 00015DF3 BF[78A90100]        <1>         mov     edi, audio_bdl_buff	; get BDL address
  3093                              <1> 	;mov	ecx, 32 / 2		; make 32 entries in BDL
  3094                              <1> 	; 06/08/2022
  3095 00015DF8 29C9                <1> 	sub	ecx, ecx
  3096 00015DFA B110                <1> 	mov	cl, 16
  3097                              <1> 
  3098 00015DFC EB05                <1> 	jmp	short s_ac97_bdl1
  3099                              <1> 
  3100                              <1> s_ac97_bdl0:
  3101                              <1> 	; set buffer descriptor 0 to start of data file in memory
  3102                              <1> 
  3103 00015DFE A1[54A90100]        <1>  	mov	eax, [audio_dma_buff]	; Physical address of DMA buffer
  3104                              <1>  
  3105                              <1> s_ac97_bdl1:
  3106 00015E03 AB                  <1> 	stosd				; store dmabuffer1 address
  3107                              <1> 
  3108 00015E04 89C2                <1> 	mov	edx, eax
  3109                              <1> 
  3110                              <1> ;
  3111                              <1> ; Buffer Descriptors List
  3112                              <1> ; As stated earlier, each buffer descriptor list is a set of (up to) 32
  3113                              <1> ; descriptors, each 8 bytes in length. Bytes 0-3 of a descriptor entry point
  3114                              <1> ; to a chunk of memory to either play from or record to. Bytes 4-7 of an
  3115                              <1> ; entry describe various control things detailed below.
  3116                              <1> ; 
  3117                              <1> ; Buffer pointers must always be aligned on a Dword boundry.
  3118                              <1> ;
  3119                              <1> 
  3120                              <1> ;IOC	equ     BIT31			; Fire an interrupt whenever this
  3121                              <1> 					; buffer is complete.
  3122                              <1> 
  3123                              <1> ;BUP	equ     BIT30			; Buffer Underrun Policy.
  3124                              <1> 					; if this buffer is the last buffer
  3125                              <1> 					; in a playback, fill the remaining
  3126                              <1> 					; samples with 0 (silence) or not.
  3127                              <1>   					; It's a good idea to set this to 1
  3128                              <1> 					; for the last buffer in playback,
  3129                              <1> 					; otherwise you're likely to get a lot
  3130                              <1> 					; of noise at the end of the sound.
  3131                              <1> 
  3132                              <1> ;
  3133                              <1> ; Bits 15:0 contain the length of the buffer, in number of samples, which
  3134                              <1> ; are 16 bits each, coupled in left and right pairs, or 32bits each.
  3135                              <1> ; Luckily for us, that's the same format as .wav files.
  3136                              <1> ;
  3137                              <1> ; A value of FFFF is 65536 samples. Running at 44.1Khz, that's just about
  3138                              <1> ; 1.5 seconds of sample time. FFFF * 32bits is 1FFFFh bytes or 128k of data.
  3139                              <1> ;
  3140                              <1> ; A value of 0 in these bits means play no samples.
  3141                              <1> ;
  3142                              <1> 
  3143 00015E06 89F0                <1> 	mov	eax, esi ; DMA half buffer size
  3144                              <1> 
  3145                              <1> 		; 04/06/2024 - Erdogan Tan
  3146                              <1> 		; NOTE: I have changed DMA half buffer size to truncated
  3147                              <1> 		; (8 byte aligned) audio buffer size for smooth audio playing
  3148                              <1> 		; (it was page border aligned before June 4, 2024)
  3149                              <1> 		;
  3150                              <1> 		; For example:
  3151                              <1> 		;    For 65416 bytes audio buffer (22kHz, 16bit samples)
  3152                              <1> 		;       (user's audio buff virtual addr is mapped to physical)
  3153                              <1> 		;	((kernel's and user's audio buff pages are same)) 
  3154                              <1> 		;    1) Memory allocation (of it) is 65536 bytes
  3155                              <1> 		;    2) DMA half buffer size is 65416 bytes
  3156                              <1> 		;	(it would be 65536 bytes before this modification)
  3157                              <1> 		;	((additional 140 bytes would cause to a noise))	     
  3158                              <1> 		;    3) Total DMA buffer size is 131072 bytes
  3159                              <1> 		;       (the last 240 bytes will not be used for playing)
  3160                              <1> 		;
  3161                              <1> 		; (buffer will be truncated if the size is not a multiple of 8) 
  3162                              <1> 
  3163 00015E08 01C2                <1> 	add	edx, eax
  3164 00015E0A D1E8                <1> 	shr	eax, 1	; count of 16 bit samples
  3165                              <1> 	; 19/11/2023
  3166 00015E0C 0D000000C0          <1> 	or	eax, IOC+BUP
  3167                              <1> 	;or	eax, IOC ; 11/06/2017
  3168 00015E11 AB                  <1> 	stosd
  3169                              <1> 
  3170                              <1> ; 2nd buffer:
  3171                              <1> 
  3172 00015E12 89D0                <1>         mov	eax, edx ; Physical address of the 2nd half of DMA buffer
  3173 00015E14 AB                  <1> 	stosd		 ; store dmabuffer2 address
  3174                              <1> 
  3175                              <1> ; set length to [audio_dmabuff_size]/2
  3176                              <1> ; Set control (bits 31:16) to BUP, bits 15:0=number of samples
