   759                              <1> ; 07/10/2016
   760                              <1> ; Table of kernel devices (which do not use installable device drivers)
   761                              <1> ; has been coded into KERNEL (trdosk9.s)
   762                              <1> ; 07/10/2016
   763                              <1> ; 8 installable device drivers available to install (NUMIDEV)
   764                              <1> ;IDEV_PGDIR: resd NUMIDEV
   765                              <1> 			; Page directories of installable device drivers
   766                              <1> 			;
   767                              <1> 			; Note: Virtual start address is always 400000h
   768                              <1> 			; (end of the 1st 4MB). [org 400000h]
   769                              <1> 			; Segments: KCODE, KDATA
   770                              <1> 			; Method: call 400000h (after changing page dir)
   771                              <1> 			; Query code located at the start (400000h).
   772                              <1> 			; Query code returns with
   773                              <1> 			;   eax = device type and driver version
   774                              <1> 			;         AL = Device Type minor
   775                              <1> 			;         AH = Device Type major
   776                              <1> 			;         Byte 16-23 : Version minor
   777                              <1> 			;	  Byte 24-31 : Version major - 1
   778                              <1> 			;		       (0:0 -> 1.0)
   779                              <1> 			;   ebx = initialization code address
   780                              <1> 			;   ecx = configuration table address
   781                              <1> 			;   edx = description table address
   782                              <1> 			;   esi = device (default) name address (ASCIIZ)
   783                              <1> 			;	 (name has "/DEV/" prefix)
   784                              <1> 			;   edi = dispatch table address
   785                              <1> 			;        (for calling kernel-device functions)
   786                              <1> 			;   ebp = address table address
   787                              <1> 			; Initialization code returns with
   788                              <1> 			;   eax = open code address
   789                              <1> 			;   ecx = close code address
   790                              <1> 			;   ebx = read code address
   791                              <1> 			;   edx = write code address
   792                              <1> 			;   esi = IOCTL code address
   793                              <1> 			;   edi = dispatch table address
   794                              <1> 			;   ebp = address table address
   795                              <1> 			; Address Table:
   796                              <1> 			;    Offset 0  : open code address
   797                              <1> 			;    Offset 4  : read code address
   798                              <1> 			;    Offset 8  : write code address
   799                              <1> 			;    Offset 12 : close code address
   800                              <1> 			;    Offset 16 : IOCTL code address
   801                              <1> 			;    Offset 20 : initialization code address
   802                              <1> 			;    Offset 24 : description table address
   803                              <1> 			;    Offset 28 : configuration table address
   804                              <1> 			;    Offset 32 : device name address
   805                              <1> 			;    Offset 36 : dispatch table address
   806                              <1> 			;          (for calling kernel-device functions)
   807                              <1> 
   808                              <1> ;IDEV_NAME:  resb 8*NUMIDEV
   809                              <1> 			  ; 8 byte names of installable device drivers
   810                              <1> 
   811                              <1> ;IDEV_TYPE:  resb NUMIDEV ; Driver type of installable device drivers
   812                              <1> ;IDEV_FLAGS: resb NUMIDEV ; Device access parameters for installable
   813                              <1>                           ; device drivers (These values are set while
   814                              <1> 			  ; the device driver is being loaded.)
   815                              <1> ;IDEV_OADDR: resd NUMIDEV ; open function addr for installable dev driver
   816                              <1> ;IDEV_CADDR: resd NUMIDEV ; close function addr for installable dev driver
   817                              <1> ;IDEV_RADDR: resd NUMIDEV ; read function addr for installable dev driver
   818                              <1> ;IDEV_WADDR: resd NUMIDEV ; write function addr for installable dev driver
   819                              <1> 
   820                              <1> ; 08/10/2016
   821                              <1> ; 07/10/2016
   822                              <1> ; Device Open and Access parameters
   823                              <1> ;DEV_ACCESS:	resb NUMOFDEVICES    ; bit 0 = accessable by normal users
   824                              <1> 				     ; bit 1 = read access permission
   825                              <1> 				     ; bit 2 = write access permission
   826                              <1> 				     ; bit 3 = IOCTL permission to users
   827                              <1> 				     ; bit 4 = block device if it is set
   828                              <1> 				     ; bit 5 = 16 bit or 1024 byte data
   829                              <1> 				     ; bit 6 = 32 bit or 2048 byte data
   830                              <1> 				     ; bit 7 = installable device driver
   831                              <1> ;DEV_R_OWNER:	resb NUMOFDEVICES    ; Reading owner no (u.uid) of devices
   832                              <1> ;DEV_R_OPENCOUNT: resb NUMOFDEVICES  ; Reading open count
   833                              <1> ;DEV_W_OWNER:	resb NUMOFDEVICES    ; Writing owner no (u.uid) of devices
   834                              <1> ;DEV_W_OPENCOUNT: resb NUMOFDEVICES  ; Writing open count
   835                              <1> ;DEV_DRIVER:	resb NUMOFDEVICES    ; device driver number (1 to 7Fh)
   836                              <1> 				     ; *if bit 7 is set (80 to FFh)
   837                              <1> 				     ; *if it is installable device driver
   838                              <1> 				     ; *index (0 to 7Fh)
   839                              <1> 				     ; otherwise it is kernel device index
   840                              <1> ;DEV_OPENMODE:	resb NUMOFDEVICES    ; 1 = read mode
   841                              <1> 				     ; 2 = write mode
   842                              <1> 				     ; 3 = read & write
   843                              <1> 				     ; 0 = not open (free)
   844                              <1> ;DEV_NAME_PTR:	resd NUMOFDEVICES    ; pointers to name addresses of drivers
   845                              <1> 				     ; Address base: KDEV_NAME+
   846                              <1> 				     ; or IDEV_NAME+
   847                              <1> ;DEV_R_POINTER:	resd NUMOFDEVICES    ; reading pointer, writing pointer
   848                              <1> ;DEV_W_POINTER:	resd NUMOFDEVICES    ; sector number if block device
   849                              <1> 				     ; character offset if char device
